title: Senior Recruiter
description:
Wij zoeken geen recruiter die wacht op sollicitaties.

adesso Nederland groeit. En de mensen die wij zoeken, zijn meestal niet actief op zoek naar een nieuwe baan.

Daarom zoeken we een Senior Recruiter die recruitment écht beheerst.

Iemand die begrijpt dat een vacature online zetten het begin is en niet de strategie.

Je weet hoe je zelf de markt in gaat. Je searcht, sourcet, benadert en bouwt relaties op. Je probeert verschillende invalshoeken als een search niet werkt. Je kent LinkedIn Recruiter, maar weet ook dat sourcing meer is dan een paar zoektermen invoeren en InMails versturen.

En misschien nog belangrijker: je hebt ideeën.

Over waar we talent kunnen vinden. Over hoe we mensen kunnen benaderen. Over employer branding. Over onze propositie als werkgever. Over tooling, data, events, referrals, communities en alles wat ons kan helpen om betere mensen aan adesso te verbinden.

Zie je een kans? Dan verwachten we niet dat je wacht tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen.

Je pakt hem.

Wat ga je doen?

Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid voor recruitment binnen adesso Nederland en werkt nauw samen met hiring managers en management.

Daarbij ben je zowel strategisch als operationeel.

Want senior zijn betekent bij ons niet dat je alleen adviseert.

Je doet het ook zelf.

Je:

  • voert zelfstandig searches uit naar schaarse IT-professionals;

  • bouwt talentpools op in plaats van pas te zoeken zodra er een vacature ontstaat;

  • benadert kandidaten persoonlijk en weet hun interesse te wekken;

  • experimenteert met nieuwe sourcingkanalen en manieren van benaderen;

  • voert intakes met hiring managers en durft kritisch te zijn op het profiel dat zij zoeken;

  • adviseert over haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, salaris en recruitmentstrategie;

  • voert gesprekken met kandidaten en begeleidt het proces van eerste contact tot hire;

  • houdt overzicht over je vacatures en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat;

  • gebruikt data om te begrijpen wat wel en niet werkt;

  • komt zelf met voorstellen om recruitment slimmer en effectiever te maken;

  • denkt mee over employer branding, referral recruitment, events en communities;

  • bouwt mee aan hoe recruitment binnen adesso Nederland zich verder ontwikkelt.

Je krijgt daarbij geen dichtgetimmerd recruitmenthandboek.

We verwachten juist dat jij vanuit je ervaring kunt zeggen:

“Dit werkt niet. Ik denk dat we het zo moeten aanpakken.”

En vervolgens help je om het te realiseren.

Wanneer ben je voor ons senior?

Niet omdat er ‘Senior Recruiter’ op je LinkedIn-profiel staat.

Voor ons zit senioriteit in hoe je werkt.

Je hoeft niet gevraagd te worden om te sourcen je weet dat het onderdeel van je vak is.

Als een search niets oplevert, concludeer je niet dat “de markt lastig is”. Je verandert je aanpak.

Als een hiring manager een onrealistisch profiel zoekt, durf je dat gesprek te voeren.

Als je ziet dat ons recruitmentproces beter kan, kom je niet alleen met het probleem maar ook met een voorstel.

En als je een goed idee hebt, krijg je energie van het daadwerkelijk uitvoeren ervan.



We zoeken iemand met stevige recruitmentervaring, bij voorkeur binnen IT, tech of consultancy.

Maar het aantal jaren ervaring vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je daadwerkelijk kunt.

We willen vooral zien dat je:

  • aantoonbaar sterk bent in search, sourcing en direct benaderen;

  • weet hoe je schaarse senior professionals vindt en interesseert;

  • verschillende sourcingstrategieën kunt bedenken én uitvoeren;

  • creatief bent in het vinden van nieuwe kandidaten en doelgroepen;

  • verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je vacatures en resultaten;

  • zelfstandig prioriteiten stelt;

  • hiring managers als volwaardig gesprekspartner adviseert;

  • kritisch durft te zijn wanneer dat nodig is;

  • nieuwsgierig bent naar nieuwe recruitmenttechnieken, tooling en AI;

  • met data naar je eigen recruitmentfunnel kijkt;

  • ideeën niet alleen bedenkt, maar ook uitvoert;

  • Nederlands en Engels professioneel beheerst.

Wat je bij ons niet hoeft te doen

Wachten tot iemand je vertelt welke Boolean search je moet gebruiken.

Wachten tot marketing met een employer-brandingidee komt.

Wachten tot een hiring manager vraagt waarom een vacature al zes weken openstaat.

Of iedere week uitleggen dat de markt nu eenmaal moeilijk is.

Natuurlijk is de IT-arbeidsmarkt moeilijk.

Dat is precies waarom we een goede Senior Recruiter zoeken.

Wat krijg je daarvoor terug?

Veel vrijheid.

Maar vrijheid betekent bij ons ook verantwoordelijkheid.

Je krijgt de ruimte om recruitment mede vorm te geven en nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. adesso werkt met korte lijnen, veel autonomie en ruimte voor initiatief. Onze Culture Code draait onder andere om hands-on, straightforward en open-minded werken.

Dat betekent: aanpakken, zeggen wat je denkt en openstaan voor betere ideeën.

Verder kun je rekenen op:

  • een vast dienstverband voor 32–40 uur per week;

  • 27 vakantiedagen;

  • 4 studiedagen per jaar;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar;

  • een mobiliteitsregeling;

  • hybride werken en flexibele werktijden;

  • een goede pensioenregeling en aanvullende verzekeringen;

  • internationale ontwikkelmogelijkheden binnen adesso;

  • en vooral: ruimte om recruitment beter neer te zetten.

Klinkt dit bekend?

Misschien zie je tijdens het lezen van deze vacature al drie dingen die je anders zou doen.

Mooi.

Dan zijn we waarschijnlijk naar jou op zoek.

We zoeken geen recruiter die onze huidige manier van werken netjes in stand houdt.

We zoeken iemand die helpt om hem beter te maken.

title: Data Management consultant
description:
Wij zijn op zoek naar een dynamische en veelzijdige Data Consultant om ons team te versterken. De ideale kandidaat beschikt over een unieke combinatie van consultancyvaardigheden, projectmanagementexpertise en een verkoopgerichte mentaliteit, samen met een diepgaand begrip van datamanagement en datastrategieprincipes. Deze rol vereist een individu die zich moeiteloos kan aanpassen aan diverse projecten en klantbehoeften, en zakelijke successen kan stimuleren door middel van effectieve datastrategieën.

Als Data & Strategy Consultant bij adesso speel je een cruciale rol in het helpen van onze klanten om het volledige potentieel van hun data te benutten. Deze functie vraagt om een professional die niet alleen de fijne kneepjes van datamanagement begrijpt, maar ook uitblinkt in projectmanagement en business development. Jouw primaire verantwoordelijkheid zal zijn om de kloof te overbruggen tussen technische data-oplossingen en zakelijke doelstellingen, zodat onze klanten weloverwogen, data-gedreven beslissingen kunnen nemen.


Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden:

Consultancy & Klantbetrokkenheid:

  • Fungeren als een vertrouwde adviseur voor klanten, waarbij je hun zakelijke behoeften begrijpt en op maat gemaakte datamanagement- en strategische oplossingen biedt.

  • Workshops en bijeenkomsten faciliteren om eisen te verzamelen, bevindingen te presenteren en actiegerichte strategieën aan te bevelen.

  • Sterke klantrelaties opbouwen en onderhouden om nieuwe zakelijke kansen te identificeren en te benutten.

For years, StackFuel has been one of Germany’s leading providers of data and AI training. Since early 2026, we have been part of Multiverse, Europe’s only EdTech unicorn and the continent’s largest AI upskilling platform. Together, we are pursuing a clear goal: to make 100,000 employees in Germany AI-ready and close the country’s data and AI skills gap.

We’re at an exciting point right now: as a scale-up, we are migrating and consolidating our infrastructure from individual systems to a scalable cloud stack, while keeping everything running and without compromising on uptime or performance. To make this happen, we’re looking for a Tech Lead AI DevOps / Infrastructure (f/m/d) to take full ownership of our infrastructure: you’ll build it, scale it, and create the foundation our team can grow on. You’ll do this with a small DevOps team that you lead. In the long term, you and your team will ensure that our engineering teams can efficiently ship their products on secure, scalable infrastructure as part of an agentic SDLC.

Your Responsibilities

  • Work as DevOps Tech Lead, meaning you’re an active contributor (player & coach) with leadership responsibility for a small team, reporting directly to our Head of Engineering

  • Own the scaling, maintenance, and security of our entire cloud infrastructure, from the ongoing migration to stable day-to-day operations, laying the foundation for team and product growth

  • Establish clean processes for monitoring, uptime, backups and recovery, access management, security updates, and cost control, in areas that have grown organically and are still largely unstructured today

  • Use AI deliberately in day-to-day DevOps work, from incident analysis to infrastructure code to runbooks, and consistently automate recurring operational tasks so a small team can achieve maximum impact

  • Ensure that internal and external development is reliably supported by DevOps

  • Prepare the team’s evolution toward platform engineering for our Berlin location

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including initial lead responsibility (architecture, technical decisions, mentoring)

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted DevOps, i.e. using AI to automate and safeguard operations and infrastructure

  • Solid knowledge of infrastructure as code and container orchestration, e.g. with Terraform, Kubernetes, and Ansible

  • Experience operating an enterprise stack with many components (data warehouses, applications, databases, logging, security audits, permission systems) and a strong sense for security, backups, and recovery

  • Discipline in CI/CD, monitoring, and observability (e.g. GitHub Actions, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar)

  • Experience operating in fast-growing environments and bringing structure and scalability to them

  • Business-fluent German and English

This Role Probably Isn’t for You If…


This role is probably not the right fit if you’d rather lead than get hands-on yourself. With a small team, you’re both Tech Lead and engineer, staying deeply involved in the system, the design, and the code. It’s also not a good fit if you expect a tidy environment with established processes: a lot of what we have has grown organically, and creating structure exactly there is a core part of your job. And if you see AI tools as a nice productivity extra rather than something that fundamentally changes how an entire team works, you probably won’t be happy here.

title: Working Student / Intern GTM AI Growth Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades – together, with modern software and smart AI solutions.
We don’t just develop software – we’re on a mission to give tradespeople and contractors more room to focus on what matters. We do this by providing a practical SaaS solution that works the way they do: fast, efficient, and without unnecessary administrative overhead. Supported by smart AI features exactly where they make a real difference in everyday work.
Backed by Tier 1 investors from Europe and the US such as Headline and Creandum, and with more than 30,000 craftspeople as our customer base, we are scaling across Europe to turn individual, scattered businesses into connected and successful communities.
We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people wearing safety boots in mind, not suits. We’re excited to shape the future together as a team, staying grounded in our mission to empower the builders and makers of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Working Student / Intern GTM AI Growth Engineering, you build and launch AI-powered growth experiments that create new qualified demand for plancraft across Europe. From interactive calculators and landing pages to AI-powered tools, you turn ideas into live experiments, measure their impact on revenue, and scale what works. You help build an automated, intelligence-driven go-to-market engine that grows without adding manual work.

Your Responsibilities

  • Build and launch AI-powered acquisition experiments using tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor – from interactive calculators and landing pages to simple AI widgets.

  • Own the experiment pipeline – collect ideas, prioritize them by expected revenue impact and effort, and continuously prepare the next tests.

  • Measure what works – define clear hypotheses, set up tracking with GA4, Mixpanel, and HubSpot, and evaluate experiments based on qualified leads, pipeline, and conversion.

  • Automate lead generation – connect experiments to HubSpot, ensuring leads are captured, qualified, and routed with clean data and minimal manual effort.

  • Scale successful experiments internationally – adapt winning tools and campaigns for international markets like Italy, Spain, and the Netherlands.

  • Document learnings and share results – write concise experiment briefs, report outcomes transparently, and present your latest experiments in our weekly RevOps meeting.

  • Turn experiments into scalable solutions – hand over successful initiatives to the responsible teams and shut down unsuccessful tests efficiently.

  • Collaborate across Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to ensure experiments follow our brand, tracking, and data standards while generating actionable insights for future growth.

YOUR PROFILE

Must-haves:

  • You’re currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program (at least two semesters completed), ideally in Industrial Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical or business-technical field.

  • You've already built and launched something independently – whether an app, website, automation, or side project. It doesn't need to be perfect, but it needs to work.

  • You're comfortable using at least one AI building tool such as Lovable, Claude, or Cursor and can understand basic HTML, JavaScript, and API documentation.

  • You understand the fundamentals of digital acquisition funnels and can connect an experiment hypothesis to a measurable outcome.

  • You take ownership from idea to execution, learn new tools independently, and prioritize shipping and learning over unnecessary perfection.

  • You communicate clearly, document your work concisely, and are comfortable sharing results openly – including experiments that didn't succeed.

  • You have fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

  • You're available for 16–20 hours per week during the semester and remain enrolled at university throughout your working student contract. For an internship, you can commit to at least four months, ideally six months.

  • You are based in Hamburg or willing to relocate to Hamburg for the duration of your internship or working student position.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Initial experience with GA4, Mixpanel, landing page optimization, SEO, copywriting, or conversion tracking.

  • Experience with automation tools like n8n or working with APIs.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, Webflow, Figma, Linear, GitHub, Asana, or Claude Code.

  • Experience launching a project with real users – whether through a startup, university initiative, personal project, or public launch.

  • Interest in tradespeople, small businesses, and understanding how digital tools can improve their daily work.

  • German skills at C1 level or additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish.

 


WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

 

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace.   • Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

description:
Mission
Integral was founded in October 2024 by Lukas Zörner and Anil Can Baykal and is one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. Core Responsibilities

  • Own your vacancies across the full cycle: intake, sourcing, screening, interview loop, debrief, offer and close.

  • Own our Ashby setup for your roles, from pipeline hygiene through templates and interview guides to reporting.

  • Keep the process at the pace we promise. Our job ads say under two weeks and candidates rely on it.

What we're not looking for

  • People who wait for a briefing before they start.

  • Anyone who sees recruiting mainly as forwarding CVs.

The Hiring Process
We move fast. For the right person, the full process takes less than two weeks.

  4. Final in person meeting to meet our team and explore the office

title: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA
description:
Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA

 

Executive summary: A senior international key account role for a professional who excels in relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and strategic account development. In this position, you will be responsible for retaining, deepening, and further strengthening the partnership with one of SITA’s ( https://www.sita.aero/about-us/ )  most strategic clients.

Highlights: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics | SITA

·      End-to-end responsibility for a strategic international key account

·      Strong focus on relationship management, retention, and deepening the partnership with C-level, IT directors, Enterprise architects, both on the IT organization of the client as well the Business organization.

·      International sales and stakeholder management role with high visibility in the customer environment

·      Significant impact on client satisfaction, continuity and commercial development, including revenue management

·      Strong focus on managed IT and Connectivity services (infrastructure) and differentiated value propositions, based on the portfolio of SITA

·      Key position within an international team and complex IT enterprise and Business environment

·      Operational / dotted leadership of a highly skilled IT team of 6 FTE at client site

 

Purpose of the role

For SITA, we are looking for a Senior Account Director who will take international responsibility for the strategic international key account. In this role, the emphasis is on retaining, deepening, and future-proofing an existing client relationship with significant commercial and operational value. The focus is not on aggressive revenue growth, but on stability, continuity and additional commercial opportunities within an established international account.

 

About the role, building future proof relationships

As Senior Account Director, you will be responsible for managing and further developing the strategic international key account within SITA. You will operate in an international environment where relationship development focusing on account retention, you understand the complexity of enterprise. IT, data and connectivity sales and know how to create structural value within an existing client relationship.

 

The ideal candidate is an experienced sales professional with proven knowledge of strategic international key account as an organization, for example from a previous role as a supplier or strategic partner. IT knowledge and experience with managed services are important, but deep client knowledge, insight into decision-making structures, and an understanding of international stakeholder dynamics are even more critical in this position. You can build sustainable relationships at multiple levels, create internal and external alignment in a smart and distinctive way.

 

About SITA

SITA has been a leading technology partner for the international travel and transport sector since 1949. In its early years, the SITA company built one of the first large-scale communications networks for aviation and today continues to play a global role in making travel and logistics processes smarter, safer, and more efficient. SITA has since expanded this expertise into maritime services and managed services for logistics organizations

 

SITA supports organizations with contact center solutions, connectivity, digital collaboration, security, and managed services. Within this context, strategic international key account for whom SITA delivers services worldwide that directly contribute to customer contact, collaboration, and operational continuity.

Client context

The strategic international key account one of the world’s leading container shipping and logistics companies, with approximately 18.000 employees globally, 340 + offices in 120 + countries, and connections to more than 550 ports worldwide. The organization is known for its strong focus on quality, digitalization, customer centricity, and operational excellence.

For this role, insight into the international dynamics of a complex logistics organization is essential. You understand how technology, service delivery, and stakeholder management come together in an environment where continuity, reliability, and client satisfaction have a direct impact on the business.

The partnership between SITA and the strategic international key account is built on a strong foundation. Your assignment will be to further deepen this relationship, strengthen SITA’s position, and carefully and strategically develop new opportunities within the account.

 

Portfolio and services at the key account

·       Contact centre and voice solutions

·       Global connectivity solutions

·       Managed services for communication and office environments

·       Management of digital workplaces and office environments

·       Security solutions

 

What will you do?

·       You will have end-to-end responsibility for the international account management strategic key account within SITA.

·       You will build and deepen sustainable relationships with stakeholders at operational, tactical, and strategic levels.

·       You will safeguard the existing revenue base and drive maximum client retention in an environment where managed services are largely viewed as a commodity.

·       You will identify commercial opportunities and translate them into distinctive, relevant, and viable propositions.

·       You will clearly operate as a farmer rather than a hunter account retention, and strategic growth is the main focus.

·       You will position SITA as a partner that adds value more intelligently, effectively, and innovatively than the market expects.

·       You will work effectively with internal teams, senior stakeholders, and specialists to serve the client optimally.

·       You will provide day-to-day direction to a highly skilled IT delivery team of 6 FTE at the client (virtual and extended account team).

 

Terms of employment

This position offers a fixed gross monthly salary between €9.000,- and €11.000,- gross monthly, complemented by an attractive variable compensation model. The bonus structure consists of a sales incentive based on revenue, with approximately 40% of the variable compensation linked to renewals. In addition, you will receive commission on closed deals. With strong performance, a total package of up to approximately €160,000 OTE is achievable.

Procedure

Following a successful introductory phone call, you will have 2 face-to-face meetings with a SoundPeople senior consultant. If both sides see sufficient reason to move forward, we will introduce you to SITA. You will then go through three interview rounds with the client:

 

The first interview round will take place with a Account Executive of SITA (Central Europe) and an HR professional. The second round will be with the SVP of Central Europe and the current Account Director. In the final stage, the ultimate selection and terms of employment will be aligned with the President of Europe and the COO.

 

Interested?

 

This opportunity is designed for an accomplished enterprise account leader who understands that a mature strategic relationship still requires energy, precision and continuous development. If you can combine executive stakeholder management with commercial ownership and coordinated delivery, we would like to hear from you.

 

Contact Sven Fremeijer at Sound People BV, Executive Search

LinkedIn:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/svenfremeijer/


Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a senior sales professional with extensive experience in complex enterprise environments and a strong understanding of international client dynamics. Ideally, you know the strategic international key account from a supplier or partner perspective and understand the organization, its decision-making processes, and the interests at play. You combine commercial sharpness with high-level know how to create momentum based on trust, substance, and personal leadership.

 

·      Proven experience in MSP, IT, managed services and/or Telco environments

·      Deep client knowledge and preferably previous experience with strategic key account

·      Creative, innovative, and strategically strong in commercial positioning

·      Excellent networker and a credible sparring partner at C-level

·      Structured, results-driven, and operationally strong

·      Able to move organizations forward through relationships and trust, rather than hierarchy or pressure

·      Must: Excellent communication skills in an international environment.

description:

Heidi Systems builds the energy OS for real estate. We help property managers and owners get their heating, water and electricity meters online, see consumption in real time and run the yearly utility billing without paper, Excel and site visits.

Submetering in Germany is still mostly analog. Meters get read by hand, data sits in PDFs, and tenants see their consumption once a year. We change that end to end: we install the meters and gateways in the building, collect the data and build the web platform property managers work in.

We're a small team in Berlin. Product and engineering work directly with the founders, and what you ship lands with real customers fast.

The role

We're looking for a best-in-class frontend engineer. Someone whose code other engineers learn from.

You'll be our senior frontend engineer and own the web platform end to end: architecture, code quality and the day-to-day experience of the property managers using it.

The platform is a SvelteKit and TypeScript app. It shows consumption data per building and unit, flags anomalies, manages tenants and owners, and produces the documents for the yearly billing. A lot of it is data-heavy UI, and it has to be right, because the numbers end up on invoices.

You'll work closely with our backend engineers and the founders, and you'll help onboard and mentor junior developers and interns as the team grows.

What you'll do

  • Own the frontend architecture of our SvelteKit app: routing, load functions, SSR, state and how we talk to the backend via oRPC

  • Ship features end to end, from a rough idea with the founders to production, often before the design is final

  • Build the data-heavy parts of the product: consumption dashboards, notification rules, tenant and owner management, billing documents

  • Set up and maintain our component library on Tailwind and DaisyUI so the UI stays consistent as we add features

  • Raise the bar on quality: strict TypeScript, Vitest coverage, code reviews, a sane PR flow

  • Shape the API contract together with backend (types, Zod schemas, error handling) so frontend and backend stay in sync

  • Mentor juniors and interns through reviews and pairing

What you bring

  • 5+ years of professional frontend experience, ideally at startups or other fast-moving product teams

  • 2+ years building production apps with Svelte and SvelteKit, with a deep understanding of its reactivity model, stores, lifecycle, routing, load functions and SSR

  • Strong TypeScript: strict mode, generics, utility types, and the judgment to know when types help and when they get in the way

  • Hands-on with Tailwind CSS (DaisyUI is a plus)

  • Experience with RPC-style APIs (oRPC, tRPC or similar) and typed contracts between frontend and backend

  • Testing as a habit: Vitest, JSDom or comparable tooling

  • Comfortable in a Unix environment (Linux or macOS), with Git, branches and PRs

  • You've made architecture decisions on a real product and can explain the trade-offs

  • You work well with little oversight and ship in small, frequent steps

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

  • You're in Berlin or willing to move, and you're in our office 2 to 3 days a week

How we work

  • Hybrid in Berlin. You're in the office 2 to 3 days a week. That's fixed. The rest of the week you work from wherever you like.

  • Short paths. You talk to the founders directly, most decisions take one call.

  • Real ownership. The frontend is yours to shape, and you'll set many of the standards the team builds on.

  • Real impact. Your work runs in buildings across Germany and makes energy use visible where people live.

  • Room to grow with the company as the engineering team gets bigger.

Your next steps

If you match most of these requirements and are ready to help digitize the building sector, we encourage you to apply. You will join a growing team where your work directly shapes the future of energy management in real estate.

Warum diese Rolle

Wir bauen Software, mit der echte Unternehmen arbeiten. Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen und schnellen Teams, in dem du als Product Owner die Produktvision und die Umsetzung von Anfang bis Ende verantwortest, statt ein Backlog abzuarbeiten, das jemand anderes vorgekaut hat. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Engineers zusammen, steuerst KI-gestützte Entwicklungsabläufe und bringst Features innerhalb weniger Wochen vom Konzept in die Produktion.

Diese Rolle ist für jemanden, der in Systemen, Nutzen für die Anwender und operativer Klarheit denkt, nicht nur in Jira-Status.

Ehrlich gesagt: KI im Jahr 2026

Wir entwickeln schnell mit modernen KI-Werkzeugen (Cursor, Claude, Copilot usw.). Als unser Product Owner musst du selbst keinen Produktivcode schreiben, aber du musst verstehen, wie KI-native Entwicklung Lieferzyklen, Aufwandsschätzung und Scoping verändert.

Die KI-Werkzeuge können Code schreiben, aber sie wissen nicht, was unsere Kunden wirklich brauchen, wie Abläufe über Unternehmen hinweg zusammenhängen oder welche Kompromisse für unsere Architektur sinnvoll sind. Genau für dieses Urteilsvermögen suchen wir dich. Die Messlatte ist nicht „Kannst du eine User-Story-Vorlage ausfüllen?“. Die Messlatte ist: Kannst du eine unübersichtliche betriebliche Realität in glasklare Produktanforderungen übersetzen, konsequent priorisieren und Entwickler wie KI-Assistenten effizient dahin lenken, das Richtige zu bauen?

Aufgaben

Was du machst

  • Du verantwortest Roadmap und Backlog: Du definierst, schneidest und priorisierst Features vom Konzept bis zur Produktion.

  • Du übersetzt übergeordnete Geschäftsziele in präzise, umsetzbare Anforderungen und Datenmodelle, mit denen unser Engineering-Team und unsere KI-Werkzeuge arbeiten können.

  • Du sorgst für reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen Stakeholdern, Entwicklern und Anwendern, auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du steuerst Sprints, räumst Hindernisse aus dem Weg und hältst das Tempo hoch, ohne unnötige Bürokratie.

  • Du prüfst ausgelieferte Features gegen die Akzeptanzkriterien und achtest auf hohe Qualität, gute UX und echten geschäftlichen Nutzen.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Produktprozesse mit unserem Wachstum weiter, hältst Feedbackschleifen kurz und die Developer Experience reibungslos.

Unser Stack und unsere Arbeitsweise

  • Methodik: agil, Lean Product Development, kurze Iterationen, wenig Bürokratie

  • Technologie: TypeScript, Python, React, Next.js, Supabase, Postgres, Cloudflare

  • KI-native Werkzeuge: Cursor, Copilot und Claude Code als fester Bestandteil unserer Entwicklung

  • Kommunikation: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

Du musst nicht programmieren, aber du sprichst fließend „Tech“ und verstehst, wie moderne Software unter der Haube gebaut wird.

Anforderungen

Was wir suchen

Must-haves

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Product Owner, Technical Project Manager oder Product Lead in der Softwareentwicklung.

  • Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gutes Englisch (mindestens C1), unverzichtbar für die Abstimmung mit Kunden, Stakeholdern und dem Team.

  • Vertrautheit mit KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung und ihren Auswirkungen auf Produktplanung und Tempo.

  • Leidenschaft für Klarheit: Du schreibst knappe Spezifikationen, Edge Cases und Akzeptanzkriterien, die keine Fragen offenlassen.

  • Selbstständige, pragmatische und proaktive Arbeitsweise.

Nice-to-haves

  • Erfahrung in Start-ups oder in schnellen, erfahrenen Produktteams.

  • Praxis mit modernen Kollaborations- und Projektwerkzeugen (Linear, Notion, GitHub Projects).

Uns sind dein Urteilsvermögen beim Strukturieren und dein Umsetzungstempo deutlich wichtiger als die Länge deines Lebenslaufs.

Benefits

  • Kleines, erfahrenes Team: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern und Engineers. Deine Entscheidungen zählen vom ersten Tag an.

Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

  • Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Bachelors degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

  • Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

  • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

  • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

  • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

  • Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

  • Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

  • Clear written communication. Mapbox is distributed across time zones and we make most decisions in documents and Slack.

Nice to have traits for this role

  • Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.

  • Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.

  • Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.

  • Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.

  • Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.

  • Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.

  • External counsel: briefing, directing and quality-controlling UK external counsel, and managing that spend.

Your Role

Zip is looking for a Senior Director of EMEA Commercial Sales to lead and scale our Commercial business across Europe.

This is a second-line leadership role. You will initially lead two frontline Commercial Sales Managers and, through them, a growing team of Account Executives. As Zip expands across Europe, you will build the leadership structure, sales capacity, and go-to-market approach required to capture that opportunity.

Your leverage comes through your managers, but this is not a role for someone who operates from a distance. You will stay close to the business: understanding the pipeline, inspecting deals, helping your managers improve their teams, and personally getting involved in the opportunities where your experience can change the outcome.

You will own the performance of EMEA Commercial end to end: the number, pipeline, forecast, talent, geographic expansion, and operating rhythm of the segment.

Commercial is already an important part of Zip's EMEA business. The opportunity now is to turn it into a scaled, predictable growth engine across the region.

You Will

  • Own EMEA Commercial performance. Deliver quarterly and annual new-business revenue targets through the frontline managers and Account Executives who report into your organization.

  • Build and develop exceptional frontline managers. Coach your leaders on pipeline management, forecasting, deal inspection, rep development, and performance management. Hold them accountable for running their businesses with the same rigor you bring to yours.

  • Scale Commercial across Europe. Determine where and when to add coverage as Zip expands into new countries and markets, and build the teams and leadership required to win locally without creating unnecessary complexity.

  • Own pipeline well before the quarter begins. Establish coverage requirements, identify future gaps early, and work across Business Development, Marketing, Partnerships, and the AE organization to address them before they become revenue problems.

  • Build a high-performance organization. Recruit outstanding managers and sellers, raise the talent bar as we grow, develop top performers, and address underperformance quickly and directly.

  • Improve the Commercial sales motion. Diagnose where performance is constrained by pipeline, execution, territory design, productivity, process, or capability and make the changes required to improve it.

  • Operate cross-functionally. Build strong partnerships with Business Development, Solution Consulting, Advisory, Marketing, Partnerships, GTM Operations, Customer, and Zip's Executive team.

  • Represent the Commercial business internally. Provide clear, credible reporting on performance, pipeline, forecast, market dynamics, competitive trends, and the investments required to continue scaling.

  • Build for where Zip is going, not where it is today. Create the leadership bench, operating model, and market coverage that will support a significantly larger EMEA Commercial organization over the next several years.

  • You have successfully led frontline sales managers, not only individual sellers.

Qualifications

title: Lead Java Developer/Solution Architect (6-month contract)
description:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

Real-time decision-support data architecture

Replacing point-to-point integration across a multi-vendor estate with a microservices architecture and a common data layer, so that operational data flows in near real time instead of over days. The work includes target-state architecture and decision records, change-data-capture ingest pipelines from upstream data services, ontology and mapping-layer design across suppliers with competing data models, separation of system, reference and insight data classes including time-series, and deployment topologies spanning cloud-hosted services down to constrained edge hardware.

Legacy-to-document-model migration at national scale

Migrating hundreds of millions of records and tens of terabytes of XML out of a legacy relational platform into a sharded document store, in support of a COBOL-to-Java microservices rewrite. The work includes a configuration-driven XML-to-JSON transformation framework backed by a versioned schema registry — twenty years of history, multiple record types and continual schema and semantic drift; CDC and streaming pipelines, or a checkpointed parallel bulk-extract alternative; a field-level mapping validation and reconciliation framework robust enough to stand up to audit; a replay and failure-diagnostics harness with dead-letter routing and idempotent re-runs; and repeated dress rehearsals toward a single cutover window with no dual running.

Monolith decomposition and data-ownership migration

Breaking a distributed monolith of well over a hundred Java services sharing a handful of database clusters into domain-owned services — moving from borrowed data to owned data without reintroducing hidden coupling. The work includes bounded-context analysis to establish which domain genuinely owns which collections, in-place data remodelling ahead of any physical move, a data-access facade with feature-flagged per-request routing between old and new stores, dual-write / backfill / reconcile / read-switch cutover lifecycles with a defined rollback at every step, cluster-to-cluster streaming and live migration tooling, and automated parallel-run and diff-on-read testing.

What you will be doing

Emphasis varies by role and programme, but MongoDB is the common thread. Every one of these engagements involves modelling for it, migrating onto it, or building on top of it, and genuine depth here is what most differentiates candidates.

Architecture and design

•      Produce high- and low-level designs, security and data architectures, and architecture decision records — and take them through client design authorities and formal governance gates

•      Make and defend architectural trade-offs in front of both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, including client technical authorities and third-party suppliers

•      Analyse real access patterns and validate target MongoDB document models against genuine throughput, query and sharding requirements before they are baselined

•      Design integration boundaries in multi-vendor programmes where you own one component and must collaborate across the seams of others

Hands-on build

•      Build production Java services and RESTful APIs (Spring Boot or similar), designed for integration by multiple consuming systems and documented to OpenAPI

•      Design and implement MongoDB document models, aggregation pipelines, indexing and sharding strategies, and integrate them cleanly into Java service layers rather than through a leaky abstraction

•      Build data pipelines: CDC and streaming ingest, transformation frameworks, checkpointed batch extract workers, and MongoDB sink configuration and tuning at terabyte scale

•      Implement access control, encryption and audit within the application and data layer, including enforcement inside the MongoDB query path, rather than bolted on around it

•      Write the tests: unit, integration, golden-record fixtures, parallel-run reconciliation, and load and stress harnesses that prove performance under realistic volumes

•      Work across both MongoDB Atlas and Enterprise Advanced, including Kubernetes-hosted deployments, and with the migration and sync tooling around them

Data modernisation and migration

•      Model relational, XML or other legacy schemas onto MongoDB document models, handling schema and semantic drift through versioned, configuration-driven mappings rather than forked code

•      Design and prove cutover mechanisms — dual-write, backfill, reconcile, read-switch, rollback — for systems where a failed migration is not an acceptable outcome

•      Build validation and reconciliation tooling that satisfies audit: completeness, field-level fidelity, and query-level equivalence between old and new

Security, access control and assurance

•      Design and implement attribute- or role-based access control models, including enforcement at the data layer and policy administration

•      Work with application-layer and field-level encryption — MongoDB client-side field level and queryable encryption, and externally managed key material

•      Produce tamper-evident audit trails and observability that answer not just what happened but why

Client-facing delivery and enablement

•      Run workshops, playbacks and sprint demonstrations; produce design documentation, integration guides and operational runbooks

•      Support knowledge transfer and upskilling of client teams — on these programmes enablement is a deliverable, not an afterthought

•      Use AI-assisted engineering tooling as part of normal delivery, within the constraints client security policy sets


Essential

•      Strong hands-on Java — building and running production services and RESTful APIs with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework

•      MongoDB — solid working experience covering document modelling, querying, aggregation pipelines and indexing, and integrating MongoDB into Java application layers. Atlas and/or Enterprise Advanced

•      Data-intensive systems — demonstrable experience of pipelines, migrations or integrations at meaningful scale, and sound reasoning about throughput, ordering, idempotency and failure recovery

•      API design — clean, well-documented REST interfaces suitable for integration by multiple consuming systems

•      Testing — genuine automated testing discipline, plus practical experience of load and stress testing against realistic volumes

•      Infrastructure and deployment — Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code, containerised deployment on Kubernetes, and AWS or a comparable cloud

•      Communication — able to write clear design documentation and hold your own in a client design authority or architecture review

•      UK resident, and either holding current UK SC clearance or clearly eligible to obtain it

For architect-level roles we additionally expect:

•      Proven design authority on a delivery of comparable size and sensitivity, while remaining hands-on enough to prototype, pair and review code

•      Experience operating inside multi-vendor or multi-supplier programmes, including holding a technical position when other suppliers hold a different one

Desirable

•      Kafka and change-data-capture tooling such as Debezium; stream processing

•      Legacy modernisation patterns — strangler fig, operational data layers, dual running and phased cutover

•      Search — Lucene-based or Atlas Search, vector search, hybrid retrieval and RAG patterns

•      Event-driven architecture and consistency patterns in distributed systems (saga, eventual consistency)

•      Oracle, COBOL or other mainframe and legacy platform familiarity

•      AI-assisted development workflows and agentic coding tools

Working context

Clinical assessment and delivery

  • Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
  • Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
  • Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
  • Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.

Case management and coordination

  • Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.

Clinical risk oversight and governance

  • Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
  • Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
  • Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
  • Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.

Clinical protocols and client enablement

  • Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.

Client relationship, insights and reporting

title: Deployment Strategist - Crypto Investigations
description:
Global Services helps Chainalysis customers turn blockchain data and investigative tools into practical results. Our customers include law enforcement, national security teams, financial institutions, and organisations across the crypto industry.

We’re looking for a Deployment Strategist, Crypto Investigations, to join Global Services and support public-sector customers in France, particularly law enforcement and intelligence teams. You’ll use your investigative experience and technical skills to help customers get the most out of Chainalysis products. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role focused on investigations and practical problem-solving rather than software engineering.

You’ll work with customers throughout their engagement with Chainalysis, from understanding their needs and conducting investigations to developing workflows, delivering training, and helping them build their own capabilities. You’ll need sound investigative judgement, strong French communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers.


In this role, you’ll:

  • Support customer engagements from initial discovery and pre-sales through investigations, solution delivery, training, and ongoing support

  • Conduct blockchain investigations using Chainalysis products, particularly Reactor

  • Work with law enforcement, intelligence, and other public-sector customers to understand their objectives and help them achieve practical results

  • Build and adapt investigative workflows, queries, reports, and dashboards using Chainalysis tools and data

  • Help customers put investigative workflows into practice and develop the skills to use Chainalysis independently

  • Build trusted customer relationships by providing practical investigative guidance and product expertise

  • Lead customer meetings, demonstrations, investigative walkthroughs, training sessions, and technical briefings

  • Support pre-sales discussions by understanding customer requirements and explaining how Chainalysis can help

  • Share customer feedback and investigative insights with Product, Engineering, Global Intel, and Sales

  • Share investigative techniques and best practices with colleagues across Global Services

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Experience conducting or supporting investigations in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, or a related field. Candidates with relevant crypto or financial-crime investigation experience from other backgrounds will also be considered

  • Experience working with public-sector, law-enforcement, intelligence, or other mission-focused stakeholders

  • Strong investigative judgement and the ability to explain findings clearly and build credibility with customers

  • The technical aptitude to learn investigative platforms and work with data; extensive software-engineering experience is not required

  • The ability to analyse complex information and communicate findings to both investigators and senior stakeholders

  • The flexibility to work across pre-sales, customer delivery, and ongoing support

  • Fluency in French, with the ability to work confidently with French-speaking customers

  • The ability to be based in France, ideally in Paris

Required Skills

Technical Skills

  • Confidence using investigative tools and the ability to develop expertise in Chainalysis Reactor

  • Ability to work with investigative data and turn customer requirements into practical workflows, queries, and reports

  • Familiarity with blockchain investigation tools or analytical workflows is an advantage; Python and SQL are not required

  • Ability to learn Chainalysis products and understand how their data can support customer investigations

Domain Expertise

  • Experience in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, financial crime, or another relevant investigative field

  • Understanding of investigative objectives, operational workflows, and the outcomes customers need to achieve

  • Ability to use investigative judgement to guide an investigation and advise customers on their approach

Customer & Communication Skills

  • Ability to build trusted customer relationships through investigative knowledge and practical support

  • Excellent spoken and written French, including the ability to explain complex investigative concepts clearly

  • Confidence leading customer meetings, briefings, demonstrations, and training sessions

  • Ability to help customers develop their own skills and use Chainalysis tools independently

Day to Day Activities

  • Conduct investigations using Chainalysis tools, primarily Reactor, based on customer requirements

  • Prepare investigative reports, workflows, queries, and other analytical outputs

  • Work directly with customers to develop and implement investigative workflows

  • Deliver hands-on training, walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions

  • Lead demonstrations, investigative briefings, and solution presentations

  • Support pre-sales discussions, technical discovery, and solution scoping

  • Gather customer feedback and share practical recommendations with Product, Engineering, and Global Intel

  • Manage multiple customer engagements while maintaining quality and responsiveness

  • Continue developing knowledge of blockchain investigations and emerging crypto-related threats

Personal Attributes

  • Curious about blockchain technology, crypto crime, and investigative techniques

  • Able to communicate clearly and adapt to different audiences

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making sound decisions in situations where the path forward may not be clear

  • Collaborative and willing to work across teams

  • Keen to develop specialist knowledge and share it with others

Nice to have experience: [icing on the cake, not a deal breaker]

  • Previous experience using Chainalysis products

  • Experience with cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain analytics, or financial-crime analysis

  • Experience in traditional finance or financial investigations

  • Experience providing expert evidence or supporting legal proceedings

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as BSA/AML, sanctions screening, MiCA, or the Travel Rule

  • Experience with data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or cloud-based analytics tools

  • Published research, intelligence reports, or other work relating to blockchain analytics or financial crime

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

140 / COFRAC).

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

title: Solutions Engineer - French Speaker
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s presales function in France and Southern EMEA. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across France and Southern EMEA.

Sales Cycle Ownership & AE Partnership

  • Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

  • Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.

  • Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

  • Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

  • Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

Demo Excellence

  • Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

  • Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

  • Develop and maintain reusable assets across demo environments, use cases, integration templates, objection handling, and industry playbooks, brought to life directly in Synthesia's platform.

  • Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface.

Product Expertise

  • Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia's platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value.

  • Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp.

  • Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem Collaboration

  • Product: share customer and prospect feedback with Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap.

  • Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards.

  • Customer Success: brief Customer Success on technical context and champion relationships at handover, so your POCs and pilots convert cleanly into production deployments.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience).

  • Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell).

  • Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer's use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires.

  • Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned.

  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect.

  • Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization.

  • Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly.

  • Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines.

  • Willing to travel for customer discovery and on-site demos as needed.

We'd be particularly excited if
