title: Embedded Engineer
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do

  • Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

  • Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

  • Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

  • Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

  • Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

  • Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

Requirements

  • Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

  • Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

  • Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

  • A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

  • Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

  • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

  • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

  • Open-source firmware contributions.

  • Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

People & team

Dit is een rol voor iemand die op een punt is gekomen waarop alleen zelf software bouwen niet meer genoeg is, maar die óók niet de hele dag in managementmeetings wil zitten.

adesso Nederland is met ongeveer 100 collega's compact genoeg om echt invloed te hebben, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een internationale organisatie met meer dan 13.000 collega's. description:
Haben Sie schon länger über eine berufliche Veränderung nachgedacht? Möchten Sie ein Unternehmen als Geschäftsführer in unserem Franchise leiten und dabei eine Aufgabe übernehmen, die wirtschaftlich attraktiv ist und echten Sinn stiftet?   • Erfurt
  • Weimar

Gebäude-Energieberatung

Die Nachfrage nach Gebäude-Energieberatung steigt stark: Kunden wollen ihre Öl- und Gaskosten senken und Immobilien zukunftssicher sanieren. Gleichzeitig fehlen vielerorts Gebäude-Energieberater – das schafft hervorragende Chancen für Quereinsteiger.

Ideal für Quereinsteiger

Sie benötigen keine umfangreichen fachlichen Voraussetzungen, um einen gebietsgeschützten Standort aufzubauen. ENERDOMO unterstützt Sie von Anfang an – auch nach der Neueröffnung.

Qualifizierung in 27 Tagen

In der hybriden ENERDOMO Akademie (Königstein/Frankfurt & Online) erhalten Quereinsteiger ein strukturiertes Einarbeitungs- und Qualifizierungsprogramm. Projektleiter, Ingenieure, Maschinenbauer, Handwerksmeister und Immobilienmakler finden bei uns einen schnellen Einstieg in alle Themen rund um die energetische Sanierung.

ENERDOMO Sanierungssprint

Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser werden in 22 Werktagen energetisch saniert. Ein Taktplan steuert die Gewerke, die parallel arbeiten. Die Sanierungssprintkoordination übernimmt Baubegleitung, Bauzeitenplanung sowie die Koordinierung der Gewerke.

Zukunftsmarkt mit Sinn

„Grüne Jobs“ sind dabei mehr als ein Trend. Umwelt- und Energieberufe gehören zu den wichtigsten Zukunftsmärkten. ENERDOMO gibt Know-how an Existenzgründer und Quereinsteiger weiter, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas Eigenes aufbauen wollen.

Aufgaben

Wir helfen Immobilienbesitzern (privat und gewerblich), Fördermittel für energetische Sanierungen zu beantragen. Dazu erstellen wir einen Sanierungsfahrplan (iSFP) und unterstützen bei den baulichen Maßnahmen.

Statt die Arbeit von Architekten, Dachdeckern oder Heizungsbauern zu ersetzen, kooperieren wir eng mit ihnen.

Als Geschäftsführer und ENERDOMO-Partner übernehmen Sie dabei folgende Aufgaben:

  • Aufbau Ihrer eigenen, lokalen Präsenz von ENERDOMO, inklusive eines Netzwerkes aus Handwerkern und eventuellen Mitarbeitern
  • Beraten von Kunden zu allen Fragen rund um die Gebäude-Sanierung und verfügbaren Fördermittel
  • Beantragen von Fördermitteln mit oder für den Kunden
  • Vor-Ort Begehung von Gebäuden zur Aufnahme von Gebäude-Daten
  • Erstellung von individuellen Sanierungsfahrplänen (iSFP) in Hottgenroth
  • Erstellungen von Zusatzleistungen wie z.B. Energieausweisen oder Heizlastberechnungen
  • Schreiben von Angeboten und Rechnungen in Lexware Office

Qualifikation

Ein erfolgreicher Geschäftsführer im Bereich der Energieberatung sollte folgende Qualifikationen mitbringen:

  • Interesse am Energiesektor: Kenntnisse über Immobilien, Produkte und Dienstleistungen sowie die Fähigkeit, sich in dieses Thema einzuarbeiten.
  • Führungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams und der Entwicklung von Geschäftsbeziehungen.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Fähigkeit, neue Ideen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten umzusetzen und Verantwortung für den erfolgreichen Betrieb des Standorts zu übernehmen.
  • Finanzielle Kenntnisse: Kenntnisse in Budgetplanung, -analyse und -berichterstattung zur Sicherstellung des erfolgreichen Betriebs.
  • Marketing- und Vertriebskenntnisse: Fähigkeit, erfolgreiche Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und den Umsatz zu steigern.
  • Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern und Geschäftspartnern zu kommunizieren und zu präsentieren.

Sie benötigen:

  • Technisches Verständnis
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit technischen Anlagen

Zusätzlich vorteilhaft: Ein Abschluss in einem technischen Studiengang oder einer berufsbildenden höheren Schule. Dies ist jedoch keine Voraussetzung bei ENERDOMO. Wir unterstützen Sie bei der Befähigungsprüfung zum Energieberater.

Quereinsteiger: Selbst wenn Sie kein Handwerksmeister, Ingenieur oder Architekt sind, können Sie mit unserer Hilfe die „Qualifikationsprüfung Energieberatung“ erfolgreich ablegen.

Benefits

  • Gestalten Sie Ihr eigenes Unternehmen innerhalb eines erprobten Geschäftsmodells
  • Profitieren Sie vom ENERDOMO-Netzwerk: Erhalten Sie die Unterstützung bestehender ENERDOMO-Partner bei fachlichen Fragen und wachsen Sie gemeinsam mit uns in einem aufstrebenden Markt.
  • Unterstützung im Marketing durch die Systemzentrale: Konzentrieren Sie sich ganz auf den Vertrieb und Ihre Kunden
  • Unterstützung beim Aufbringen der Startgebühr und der Finanzierung der Selbstständigkeit mithilfe fachkundiger Inhouse-Beratung durch einen unserer Experten wie zum Beispiel Dr. Arthur Schäfer

CO₂ runter, Umsätze hoch! Mit ENERDOMO gestalten wir aktiv die energetische Zukunft der Immobilienberatung. Mit einer starken Marke. Aber noch wichtiger: mit starken Partnern.

Deshalb rücken wir am liebsten Menschen wie Patrik Brings ins Rampenlicht. Denn letztlich geht es nicht um Logos, sondern um echte Persönlichkeiten – mit Profil, klarer Haltung und einer echten Story. Warum setzen wir so auf Personal Branding?Weil Menschen am liebsten mit Menschen zusammenarbeiten.

Weil Persönlichkeit die besten Kunden anzieht – und gleichzeitig die passenden Mitarbeiter. Weil jeder Partner einzigartig ist und genau das sichtbar werden soll.

Patrik hat sich entschieden, Gesicht zu zeigen – heute steht er nicht nur für ENERDOMO, sondern ist die Adresse Nr. 1 in Koblenz, wenn es um energetische Sanierung geht.

Brings sagt: „Die Entscheidung für ENERDOMO war eine der besten meines Lebens. Jetzt unterstütze ich Menschen dabei, ihre Immobilien zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Diese Aufgabe ist wirtschaftlich äußerst attraktiv und gibt meinem Leben einen echten Sinn."

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About Valova

We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients.

Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs, while most German hospitals already operate at a loss.

We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash. Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital, until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe.

Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin. Join us!

Why this role matters

Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital. Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand.

That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer, you own technical go-lives from start to finish: from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team.

Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management where others do the building. And it’s not a desk job: you’ll regularly be on site in hospitals

How the role sits in the team

You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on connectors, deployments and internal tooling. With Malte and our product team, you turn what you see in hospitals into clear requirements. In hospital projects, you work hand in hand with our customer success and sales team and on the hospital side with IT leads, KIS vendors, coders and medical controlling.

What you will do

  • Bring hospitals live: You take hospitals from sandbox to production, deploy Valova on hospital VMs and connect it to KIS systems such as SAP i.s.h.med, Orbis or Dedalus.

  • Build the connections: You build and maintain interfaces (HL7, FHIR, archive and document exports) together with hospital IT and their partners.

  • Set up Valova for each customer: You configure document types, case filtering, department rules and coding workflows.

  • Learn from the ward: You work on site with coders and medical controlling and turn their friction into clear product requirements.

  • Make deployments repeatable: You write the code that makes the next go-live faster: connectors, scripts, monitoring and internal tooling.

  • Earn the hospital’s trust: You answer technical questions in security and data protection reviews (BSI C5, GDPR).

What we are looking for:

  • Engineering experience: At least two years in software engineering, and you’re comfortable with Linux, Docker and basic networking.

  • Integration know-how: You’ve worked on system integrations. Experience with HL7/FHIR or SAP environments is a big plus.

  • Customer focus: You enjoy working with customers and explain technical topics clearly to IT leads and coders alike.

  • High ownership: You move things forward, even when three parties are involved.

  • Travel: You’re happy to spend around 30 percent of your time at hospitals across Germany.

  • Languages: You speak fluent German and English, since our customers work in German.

  • Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin.

Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you!

What you get

  • Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system.

  • Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined.

  • Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals.

  • Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%.

  • Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here than in three years elsewhere, across models, infrastructure, product and customers, with a team that has a proven track record of deploying AI in healthcare.

  • One team, in the heart of the city. We work together on-site at WeWork Odeonsplatz in Munich and WeWork in central Berlin. Fully serviced offices with coffee, meeting rooms and phone booths mean zero admin, and the city-center location means short commutes, easy access to customers and investors, and lunch spots around every corner.

  • Team events that bring Munich and Berlin together, because the people you build with should also be the people you celebrate with.

What success looks like

  • After 3 months, you know Valova’s stack inside out and have taken a hospital through its first technical setup together with our team.

  • After 6 months, you’ve taken at least two hospitals live, and a new KIS connection takes weeks instead of months.

  • After 12 months, our deployments are largely repeatable: connectors, scripts and monitoring you built make every go-live faster.

  • Throughout, what you learn in hospitals shapes our roadmap, and hospital IT teams see you as their trusted contact at Valova.

How it works

Just upload your CV with your application. We’ll get in touch with you for the next steps:

  1. Intro call (30 min): We get to know each other, talk about your background and answer your first questions.

  2. Technical interview with Christian (CTO) (60 min): We dive into your engineering experience and the integrations you’ve built.

  3. Case: You work through a realistic hospital integration scenario and present it to the team.

  4. References: We speak with two or three people you’ve worked with, such as former managers or colleagues.

  5. Meet the team: You spend a day with us on-site in Munich or Berlin, meet our founders Sophia and Christian and see how we work day to day.

  6. Offer: If it’s a match for both sides, you’ll hear from us quickly.

We look forward to your application, regardless of gender, background, religion, disability, age or sexual identity.

title: AI/ML Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About Valova

We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients.

Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs, while most German hospitals already operate at a loss.

We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash. Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital, until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe.

Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin. Join us!

Why this role matters

Our agents are the product. Every case Valova codes runs through agentic systems that read clinical documentation, apply coding rules and justify every decision. How accurate, how fast and how efficient these systems are decides how much revenue hospitals recover and how much time coders get back. As AI/ML Engineer, you own the core of Valova: the agents that turn long, unstructured German clinical documentation into codes a hospital can bill and defend. You decide how we combine large and small models, how we measure quality and how new research makes it into production within weeks, not quarters.

Your impact is directly measurable: in coding accuracy, in token costs per case and in hospitals that trust every decision because they can trace it.

This is a hands-on engineering role building AI systems in production with real users. It’s not academic research, and it’s not prompt tinkering on the side of a product others build.

How the role sits in the team

You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on the agent pipeline, infrastructure and evaluation. With Malte and our product team, you translate what is technically possible into product decisions. Our doctors and coding experts are your sparring partners for clinical quality, and our forward deployed team brings back how the agents perform in real hospitals.

Du berichtest direkt an Christian, unseren CTO, und arbeitest täglich mit unserem Engineering-Team an der Agenten-Pipeline, der Infrastruktur und der Evaluation. Mit Malte und unserem Produktteam übersetzt Du, was technisch möglich ist, in Produktentscheidungen. Unsere Ärzt:innen und Kodierexpert:innen sind Deine Sparringspartner für klinische Qualität, und unser Forward-Deployed-Team bringt zurück, wie die Agenten in echten Kliniken performen.

What you will do

  • Build state-of-the-art agents: You build high-performing agentic systems that define the state of the art in healthcare text processing, while staying efficient in token usage and leveraging small models wherever possible.

  • Make every decision traceable: You ensure every decision and output of our agents is traced, and you monitor their performance in production.

  • Measure what matters: You build the evaluation and benchmarking setup that tells us, on every change, whether our agents got better or worse.

  • Bring research to production: You follow new AI/ML approaches, benchmark promising ideas and make sure the best results reach production within weeks.

  • Shape the product: You use your AI/ML expertise to evaluate future projects and inform product decisions.

What we are looking for:

  • Production experience: At least two years building and shipping ML/AI systems in production.

  • LLM and agent expertise: Strong experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks.

  • Engineering depth: Strong proficiency in your primary programming language.

  • Evaluation mindset: Experience with observability, evaluation and benchmarking of ML systems.

  • Product mindset: You care about outcomes that lead to great user experiences and are passionate about using LLMs in real-world scenarios rather than academic research.

  • Nice to have: Experience in healthcare, regulated environments or with sensitive data.

  • Languages: You speak fluent English. German is a big plus, since the clinical documents our agents process are in German.

  • Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin.

Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you!

What you get

  • Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system.

  • Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined.

  • Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals.

  • Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%.

  • Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here than in three years elsewhere, across models, infrastructure, product and customers, with a team that has a proven track record of deploying AI in healthcare.

  • One team, in the heart of the city. We work together on-site at WeWork Odeonsplatz in Munich and WeWork in central Berlin. Fully serviced offices with coffee, meeting rooms and phone booths mean zero admin, and the city-center location means short commutes, easy access to customers and investors, and lunch spots around every corner.

  • Team events that bring Munich and Berlin together, because the people you build with should also be the people you celebrate with.

What success looks like

  • After 3 months, you know our agent pipeline inside out, every agent decision is traced, and you have shipped your first improvement to production.

  • After 6 months, our evaluation and benchmarking setup runs on every change, and you have measurably improved coding quality or reduced token costs per case.

  • After 12 months, at least one new approach from research is running in production, and parts of our pipeline run on smaller models without losing quality.

  • Throughout, our AI-related product decisions are grounded in your benchmarks, and the team turns to you when a new model or method comes out.

How it works

Just upload your CV with your application. We’ll get in touch with you for the next steps:

  1. Intro call (30 min): We get to know each other, talk about your background and answer your first questions.

  2. Technical interview with Christian (CTO) (60 min): We dive into the ML/AI systems you’ve built and how you evaluated them in production.

  3. Case: You design an agentic approach for a realistic clinical coding problem, including how you would evaluate it, and present it to the team.

  4. References: We speak with two or three people you’ve worked with, such as former managers or colleagues.

  5. Meet the team: You spend a day with us on-site in Munich or Berlin, meet our founders Sophia and Christian and see how we work day to day.

  6. Offer: If it’s a match for both sides, you’ll hear from us quickly.

We look forward to your application, regardless of gender, background, religion, disability, age or sexual identity.

description:

In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores. 

During the years we've invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it's the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations' quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong.

About the Support Analytics Team

Our Support Analytics team's main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡 

You'll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the Workforce Management (WFM) team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.

What we offer

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. title: Business Development & Sales Intern (w/m/d)
description:
Über Valova

Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann.

Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben.

Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden.

Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Warum diese Rolle zählt

Als Praktikant:in im Business Development & Sales sorgst Du dafür, dass unser Vertriebsteam seine Zeit mit den richtigen Kliniken verbringt. Du findest und qualifizierst die Accounts, eröffnest die ersten Gespräche und buchst die Demos, die dann unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen wahrnehmen. Gleichzeitig baust Du den Motor dahinter mit auf: saubere Daten in unserem CRM Tool, Outreach-Sequenzen, die laufen, Dashboards, die zeigen, wo wir stehen, und KI-Automatisierungen, die unserem Team jede Woche Stunden sparen.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du direkt anhand der gebuchten Termine, einer aufgebauten Pipeline und Prozessen, die weiterlaufen, lange nachdem Du sie aufgesetzt hast.

Du sitzt nicht in der zweiten Reihe und schaust zu. Du baust den Vertriebsmotor mit auf, der Valova in Kliniken in ganz Deutschland bringt.

Deine Rolle im Team

Du berichtest an unseren VP Sales und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Regional Sales Manager:innen im Norden und Süden zusammen. Für viele Kliniken bist Du der erste Kontakt: Du recherchierst Accounts, gehst Inbound Leads nach, sprichst Entscheider:innen per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail an und übergibst qualifizierte Termine an die Regional Sales Manager:innen, die sie bis zur Unterschrift bringen. Neben dem Outreach unterstützt du RevOps & Enablement, einen Bereich, den aktuell unser VP Sales selbst führt und gestaltest so von innen mit, wie unser Vertrieb arbeitet. Eng zusammen arbeitest Du außerdem mit unserem Marketing bei Kampagnen und Events sowie mit unseren Kodierexpert:innen und dem medizinischen Team, um zu verstehen, worauf es Kliniken wirklich ankommt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Türen zu Kliniken öffnen: Du identifizierst vielversprechende Kliniken, von privaten Klinikgruppen über kommunale und ländliche Häuser bis zu Unikliniken, recherchierst die richtigen Entscheider:innen in Geschäftsführung, Finanzen, Medizincontrolling und Kodierung und gehst Inbound Leads schnell nach.

  • Qualifizieren und Demos buchen: Du findest heraus, ob echter Bedarf besteht, wer entscheidet und wann und buchst Demos für unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen mit sauberer Übergabe.

  • Unsere Pipeline up-to-date halten: Du hältst unser CRM sauber, baust Dashboards und bereitest Pipeline- und Forecast-Reportings für unseren VP Sales vor.

  • Mit KI automatisieren: Du baust KI-gestützte Workflows und Automatisierungen für Recherche, Datenanreicherung und Outreach, damit unser Team weniger Zeit mit Routine und mehr Zeit mit Kliniken verbringt.

  • Unseren Vertrieb mitgestalten: Du schreibst SOPs, schärfst Sequenzen und Playbook, unterstützt den Deal Desk bei Angeboten und Business Cases und recherchierst den Klinikmarkt und unseren Wettbewerb.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Du hast bereits durch ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudententätigkeit in Vertrieb, Business Development, Beratung oder einem Start-up praktische Erfahrung gesammelt.

  • Keine Scheu vorm Telefon: Du gehst gern auf Menschen zu, auch auf erfahrene Entscheider:innen, und bleibst nach einem „Nein“ freundlich und hartnäckig.

  • Neugier aufs Gesundheitswesen: Du willst verstehen, wie Krankenhäuser funktionieren. Erste Kenntnisse in DRG-Systematik oder ICD/OPS-Kodierung sind ein Plus, kein Muss.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch verhandlungssicher oder als Muttersprache und Englisch fließend.

  • Arbeitsort: Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin oder München

Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ownership ab Tag eins: Du verantwortest Deine eigene Pipeline und treibst den Erfolg von Valova in Deine Vertriebsregion maßgeblich voran.

  • Direkter Draht zur Vertriebsleitung. Du arbeitest täglich eng mit Stephan zusammen, unserem VP Sales und erfahrenen Scale-up-Executive. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

title: Software engineer, AI model supply chain and package security
description:
We build fast, modern developer tools in Rust, and a surprising amount of serious software runs on them. Pixi, rattler and rattler-build are open source and used by hundreds of thousands of developers: quant teams in finance, physicists at CERN, biotech labs, and humanoid robot companies you've probably seen videos of. We are also core maintainers of conda-forge, one of the largest open source package ecosystems, and we maintain RoboStack, which gets ROS running on any OS from a single lockfile.

When that much software flows through your tools, security stops being optional. Every package that ends up on a laptop, a server or a robot should be traceable back to the source and build that produced it. We're building that for conda today, and we want to extend it to AI models.

The engineering team is spread across Europe (Netherlands, Germany, UK, Moldova). This work is based in Berlin, and so is this role.

The work

Robots increasingly run learned models: vision transformers, RL policies, LLMs. Today those models are usually copied onto machines as large opaque files, with little record of where they came from or what changed. We think models should be shipped like packages: versioned, signed, verifiable, and updated efficiently.

You'll work on two related areas.

Package security. Signing and verification for conda packages with Sigstore, provenance from source to build to install, SBOMs, and mapping known vulnerabilities onto the packages people actually use. This work goes into Pixi, rattler and conda-forge, and is used by a lot of people.

AI models as packages. Taking the same ideas to model artifacts. That includes:

  • A provenance chain from training through packaging to deployment, with signatures that can be verified offline on air-gapped robots

  • A model SBOM format, building on CycloneDX's ML-BOM

  • Delta updates between model versions (full models, fine-tunes, LoRA adapters, quantized variants), so robots don't download gigabytes for a small change

  • Compression that combines model techniques (quantization, pruning, distillation) with what package managers already do well (zstd, content-addressable storage), tuned to the target hardware and network

  • Managing models that get fine-tuned on the robot itself: tracking where those variants came from, validating them, and syncing them back

  • Testing the whole pipeline end to end on real models and real hardware, and measuring latency, bandwidth and model quality

A lot of this is new. Part of the job is figuring out which approaches work, measuring them honestly, and writing up what you found.

What we're looking for

You don't need years of experience. You do need solid fundamentals, curiosity, and the patience to get security details right.

  • Rust, or a strong background in C++, Go or Python and the wish to switch

  • Interest in software supply chain security. Bonus if you've worked with Sigstore (Cosign, Rekor, Fulcio), TUF, in-toto, SLSA or SBOM formats

  • Familiarity with ML in practice: you've trained or fine-tuned a model, know what a LoRA adapter or a quantized model is, and have used PyTorch or similar

  • Basic understanding of cryptography as an engineer: signatures, hashes, certificates, and what they do and don't guarantee

  • You like measuring things and are honest about results that don't work out

  • You live in Berlin or are willing to move here

It's a plus if you know package managers from the inside, have worked on model compression or edge inference, have robotics experience, or have contributed to open source. None of this is required.

What we offer

You'll work on problems few people have solved yet, together with the people who created Mamba, Pixi, rattler and RoboStack. Most of your work will be open source and used by a large community from day one. We pay a competitive Berlin salary, with 30 days of vacation, the hardware you want, a conference budget, and time for upstream open source work. We help with relocation within the EU.

Caspar Health builds digital rehabilitation products that enable patients to continue their therapy beyond the clinic and help therapists support them more efficiently.

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer in our Healthcare Professionals Squad, you will build and improve the interface therapists use to manage their daily work. Working across our Ruby on Rails backend and React and TypeScript frontend, you will shape solutions with Product and Design and take them from an initial problem through to production.

You will join a cross-functional team of four engineers and a UX/UI Designer. Together, you will improve how healthcare professionals communicate with patients and deliver therapy—while shaping the architecture, reliability and maintainability of the underlying software.

We appreciate your expertise and wish to provide full transparency regarding the compensation range for this role. Your starting salary will be aligned with your qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and market benchmarks. Remuneration for this position follows our internal salary bands and ranges from €76,000 to €82,000 gross annually (based on a full-time 40-hour work week).

This role is located in Germany and requires full physical presence within the country. Due to our existing payroll and social security framework, permanent remote employment from abroad is not supported. Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany and resident from their first day. Please be advised that we cannot offer visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time.

Ideal für Quereinsteiger

Sie benötigen keine umfangreichen fachlichen Voraussetzungen, um einen gebietsgeschützten Standort aufzubauen. ENERDOMO unterstützt Sie von Anfang an – auch nach der Neueröffnung.

Qualifizierung in 27 Tagen

In der hybriden ENERDOMO Akademie (Königstein/Frankfurt & Online) erhalten Quereinsteiger ein strukturiertes Einarbeitungs- und Qualifizierungsprogramm. Projektleiter, Ingenieure, Maschinenbauer, Handwerksmeister und Immobilienmakler finden bei uns einen schnellen Einstieg in alle Themen rund um die energetische Sanierung.

ENERDOMO Sanierungssprint

Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser werden in 22 Werktagen energetisch saniert. Ein Taktplan steuert die Gewerke, die parallel arbeiten. Die Sanierungssprintkoordination übernimmt Baubegleitung, Bauzeitenplanung sowie die Koordinierung der Gewerke.

Zukunftsmarkt mit Sinn

„Grüne Jobs“ sind dabei mehr als ein Trend. Umwelt- und Energieberufe gehören zu den wichtigsten Zukunftsmärkten. ENERDOMO gibt Know-how an Existenzgründer und Quereinsteiger weiter, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas Eigenes aufbauen wollen.

Aufgaben

Wir helfen Immobilienbesitzern (privat und gewerblich), Fördermittel für energetische Sanierungen zu beantragen. Dazu erstellen wir einen Sanierungsfahrplan (iSFP) und unterstützen bei den baulichen Maßnahmen.

Statt die Arbeit von Architekten, Dachdeckern oder Heizungsbauern zu ersetzen, kooperieren wir eng mit ihnen.

Als Geschäftsführer und ENERDOMO-Partner übernehmen Sie dabei folgende Aufgaben:

  • Aufbau Ihrer eigenen, lokalen Präsenz von ENERDOMO, inklusive eines Netzwerkes aus Handwerkern und eventuellen Mitarbeitern
  • Beraten von Kunden zu allen Fragen rund um die Gebäude-Sanierung und verfügbaren Fördermittel
  • Beantragen von Fördermitteln mit oder für den Kunden
  • Vor-Ort Begehung von Gebäuden zur Aufnahme von Gebäude-Daten
  • Erstellung von individuellen Sanierungsfahrplänen (iSFP) in Hottgenroth
  • Erstellungen von Zusatzleistungen wie z.B. Energieausweisen oder Heizlastberechnungen
  • Schreiben von Angeboten und Rechnungen in Lexware Office

Qualifikation

Ein erfolgreicher Geschäftsführer im Bereich der Energieberatung sollte folgende Qualifikationen mitbringen:

  • Interesse am Energiesektor: Kenntnisse über Immobilien, Produkte und Dienstleistungen sowie die Fähigkeit, sich in dieses Thema einzuarbeiten.
  • Führungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams und der Entwicklung von Geschäftsbeziehungen.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Fähigkeit, neue Ideen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten umzusetzen und Verantwortung für den erfolgreichen Betrieb des Standorts zu übernehmen.
  • Finanzielle Kenntnisse: Kenntnisse in Budgetplanung, -analyse und -berichterstattung zur Sicherstellung des erfolgreichen Betriebs.
  • Marketing- und Vertriebskenntnisse: Fähigkeit, erfolgreiche Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und den Umsatz zu steigern.
  • Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern und Geschäftspartnern zu kommunizieren und zu präsentieren.

Sie benötigen:

  • Technisches Verständnis
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit technischen Anlagen

Zusätzlich vorteilhaft: Ein Abschluss in einem technischen Studiengang oder einer berufsbildenden höheren Schule. Dies ist jedoch keine Voraussetzung bei ENERDOMO. Wir unterstützen Sie bei der Befähigungsprüfung zum Energieberater.

Quereinsteiger: Selbst wenn Sie kein Handwerksmeister, Ingenieur oder Architekt sind, können Sie mit unserer Hilfe die „Qualifikationsprüfung Energieberatung“ erfolgreich ablegen.

Benefits

  • Gestalten Sie Ihr eigenes Unternehmen innerhalb eines erprobten Geschäftsmodells
  • Profitieren Sie vom ENERDOMO-Netzwerk: Erhalten Sie die Unterstützung bestehender ENERDOMO-Partner bei fachlichen Fragen und wachsen Sie gemeinsam mit uns in einem aufstrebenden Markt.
  • Unterstützung im Marketing durch die Systemzentrale: Konzentrieren Sie sich ganz auf den Vertrieb und Ihre Kunden
  • Unterstützung beim Aufbringen der Startgebühr und der Finanzierung der Selbstständigkeit mithilfe fachkundiger Inhouse-Beratung durch einen unserer Experten wie zum Beispiel Dr. Arthur Schäfer

Echte Einblicke: Franchise-Partner:innen berichten von ihren Erfahrungen

CO₂ runter, Umsätze hoch! Mit ENERDOMO gestalten wir aktiv die energetische Zukunft der Immobilienberatung. Mit einer starken Marke. Aber noch wichtiger: mit starken Partnern.

Deshalb rücken wir am liebsten Menschen wie Patrik Brings ins Rampenlicht. Denn letztlich geht es nicht um Logos, sondern um echte Persönlichkeiten – mit Profil, klarer Haltung und einer echten Story. Warum setzen wir so auf Personal Branding?Weil Menschen am liebsten mit Menschen zusammenarbeiten.

Weil Persönlichkeit die besten Kunden anzieht – und gleichzeitig die passenden Mitarbeiter. Weil jeder Partner einzigartig ist und genau das sichtbar werden soll.

Patrik hat sich entschieden, Gesicht zu zeigen – heute steht er nicht nur für ENERDOMO, sondern ist die Adresse Nr. 1 in Koblenz, wenn es um energetische Sanierung geht.

Brings sagt: „Die Entscheidung für ENERDOMO war eine der besten meines Lebens. Jetzt unterstütze ich Menschen dabei, ihre Immobilien zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Diese Aufgabe ist wirtschaftlich äußerst attraktiv und gibt meinem Leben einen echten Sinn."

Du fühlst dich davon angesprochen und tickst ähnlich wie wir bei ENERDOMO – Das Original?

You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the market.

• Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought.

• Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it.

• Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact.

• Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners.

• Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it.

.

Essential

• 1-2 years AI engineering, software engineering or intelligent automation, including LLM or AI features that real users depended on.

• Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex).

• Strong communication skills — you will spend real time with operations staff who are experts in customs and not in AI.

• Professional fluency in English.

Desirable

• Evaluation engineering: building eval harnesses and regression suites for non-deterministic systems, LLM-as-judge approaches, and human-in-the-loop review design. This is the single strongest signal we look for and we will weight it heavily.

• Context engineering: designing and version-controlling what a model sees — retrieval strategy, memory, tool descriptions, and policy layers that constrain what an agent is allowed to do.

Send us your CV and a short note a few paragraphs is plenty describing one system you have put in front of real users. We are most interested in what went wrong with it and what you did about that.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
Hi 👋 I’m Nitesh, Engineering Manager at hyperexponential. I'm one for the career mentors in the Product Foundations stream. This won’t be a traditional, hierarchical security function. Our engineers go straight to the person who owns an issue and ask them to fix it, and you’ll help define what security looks like in that model.

There’s no established playbook for this yet, which is what makes it exciting. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, I’d love to hear from you.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Security function

The Security function's mission is to safeguard the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of our customers' data and hx's systems. By fostering a culture of vigilance, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement, we maintain the highest standards of security excellence.

Security at hx underpins every product and every customer interaction. As we scale our multi-product platform globally and adopt AI across the business, the team ensures that innovation and growth are matched with rigorous security practices. We design controls, shape culture, and guide decisions that protect our business, our customers, and the wider industry.

As a Senior Security Engineer, you’ll be the second engineer in our security team, working directly alongside our Staff Security Engineer. The foundations are in place, with our core tooling chosen, rolled out and onboarded across our repositories and cloud environments. Much of how security works at hx is still to be built, though, so you’ll have real autonomy to shape it, with a direct line to the teams who own the issues you find. You’ll strengthen hx’s security posture by driving continuous improvement across our technical teams: owning security reviews, running and extending our security tooling, and turning findings into fixes, often by writing the code or making the infrastructure change yourself. You’ll champion security initiatives across the organisation, help teams adopt AI securely, and use AI to multiply your own impact. This role combines hands-on technical depth, ownership and influence to make security a practical part of how our teams work every day.

Check out our Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

  • Modify, maintain, and extend our security tooling across engineering and IT environments, including CSPM, SAST, SCA, and secret scanning, ensuring it's reliable, well tuned, and genuinely useful to the teams who depend on it.

  • Use our tooling and your own judgement to proactively identify gaps across cloud security, dependencies, secrets, and code. Work with the owning teams (starting with 2 to 3 where the gaps are greatest) to secure their commitment to prioritise remediation, and see it through.

  • Write code and make infrastructure changes yourself to fix security issues and improve our tooling, rather than just recommending improvements.

  • Own security reviews end to end, partnering with engineering teams on new designs, significant changes, and new tools, and working through follow-up questions and challenges until each review is resolved.

  • Take ownership of and complete a medium-sized security project within your first three months.

  • Partner with our IT team on security best practice, helping implement practical improvements in authentication, authorisation, and security hygiene across our corporate environment.

  • Guide teams across the business on adopting AI securely, from assessing new AI tools and use cases to mitigating risks like data leakage and prompt injection, while using AI yourself to increase your impact.

  • Support our compliance programmes, such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2, by helping teams implement and evidence technical controls.

  • Act as a trusted voice for our technical teams, owning security issues raised with them through to resolution and handling the related correspondence.

What you'll need to have done

  • Secured AWS cloud environments hands-on: using Cloud Security tooling to find common weaknesses, and fixing them yourself through infrastructure and code changes. Cloud Security experience is required.

  • Secured containerised workloads and infrastructure-as-code, catching issues before they reach production.

  • Experience working with SAST, SCA, and secret scanning tools, including triaging findings, filtering out false positives, and partnering with engineering teams to get real fixes shipped

  • Supported compliance efforts such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or GDPR by implementing and evidencing technical controls.

  • Used AI to improve your own security work and helped others adopt it safely, with a practical understanding of AI-specific risks such as data leakage, prompt injection, and agents and integrations with excessive permissions.

  • Spotted and addressed non-technical risks, such as weak processes, risky behaviours, and gaps between teams, that can undermine technical security.

  • Discussed security in depth with engineering teams, explaining complex concepts clearly and concisely and influencing teams through to implementation.

  • Taken ownership of security projects and initiatives and driven them to completion independently.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer to advise from the sidelines rather than writing code and making the infrastructure changes yourself.

  • You see security as a gatekeeping function rather than a service to the teams you support, whose adoption and trust determine your success.

  • You'd rather wait for direction than take ownership of issues, follow them through to resolution, and manage the correspondence around them.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Talent Interview (30 minutes)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)

  3. Skills Assessment (120 minutes)

  4. Values Interview (60 minutes)

  5. Meet the CEO (30 minutes)

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

title: Research Engineer (Materials Foundation Models)
description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

To scale our scientific intelligence and data curation capabilities, we are looking for three Research Engineers* to train and evaluate the foundation models behind our materials discovery platform: representation learning over crystal structures and properties, LLM fine-tuning and post-training for scientific tasks, and the evaluation and data work that makes those models useful. You will work in a small team where each person owns a model end to end, from data and experiment design through training at scale to integration.

*Note that you would be joining as a ‘Member of Technical Staff’, but the job title above hopefully helps to explain the nature of this role.



Your Impact

You will be responsible for building and training specialised foundation models on terabytes of scientific data at massive scale, fundamentally enhancing our platform's multi-modal capabilities.

The modalities span crystal structures, properties, text and images. Depending on your background you may lead on self-supervised representation learning, LLM fine-tuning and post-training (SFT, RL), or the evaluation suites that decide between them.

What You Will Do


Research and Model Training at Scale

  • Design and run experiments: scaling studies, ablations and evaluations that settle which modelling choices survive.

  • Lead efforts in parallel training of multi-modal foundation models at scale (e.g. orchestrating parallel training across hundreds of GPUs and handling data in the order of Terabytes).

  • Apply strong software engineering best practices to ensure the systems are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

  • Own the data curation and evaluation design for your models; these outlast the modelling decisions.

Scientific Collaboration & Integration

  • Partner closely with our Chemists and Materials Scientists to integrate computational and experimental workflows into one seamless optimisation loop.

  • Be proactive in learning the technical vocabulary of materials science and experimental chemistry to facilitate meaningful interactions with domain experts.

  • Contribute to our mission by ensuring all system designs align with CuspAI's commitment to sustainability and world-changing challenges.


Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are someone who gets excited about the opportunity to enable scientists to work on world changing challenges in this domain, with a personal interest in the potential applications of the technology that CuspAI is building.

  • Strong software engineering skills and a proven track record of building complex, high-performance systems at scale in a production or industrial environment.

  • Hands-on experience training or evaluating large models in a distributed setting. For senior candidates this means having led a multi-hundred-GPU training effort; for earlier-career candidates, having been a core contributor to one.

  • Depth in at least one of: large-scale vision or representation learning, LLM pre-training or post-training, reinforcement learning. We care more about one substantial, scale-y project than about breadth.

  • A deep interest in the connection between AI and materials science or chemistry, and a willingness to rapidly learn the scientific vocabulary of the discipline.

  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience. We are hiring across levels: from strong early-career research engineers (typically 1 to 3 years at a frontier lab or equivalent) to senior and staff engineers who have led model programmes.

  • Experience with representation learning and computer vision, e.g. self-supervised or contrastive pre-training, learning embeddings, or building models that pull structured information out of images such as figures, plots and diagrams.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • RL for post-training (RLHF, GRPO-style methods) or RL in agentic settings.

  • Experience at a frontier lab or a team that ships models at scale.

  • Prior experience applying machine learning models specifically to problems in materials science, chemistry, or molecular informatics.

  • Exposure to multi-modal training (e.g. text, vision, etc.) and how to combine modalities in a meaningful way.


Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to our other offices for collaboration and project oversight.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

title: Scientific Product Director, Clinical Prediction
description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

Our clinical-prediction offer gives pharma partners the evidence to guide decisions before and during clinical development. We are looking for a Scientific Product Director to turn this science into sellable products: decide what gets developed and when, define what each capability can claim and output, and shape how results are delivered to partners.

You will report to Gustave Ronteix, CTO and co-founder, and work daily with a tight-knit interdisciplinary team composed of Computational Biology, Data Science, R&D, Platform Strategy & Operations, BD and Pharma Partnerships.

What you'll do

1. Own the product roadmap

  • Design and build a scalable product capable of derisking and accelerating clinical development of drug candidates based on Orakl’s scientific capabilities

  • Turn signals from BD, Pharma Partnerships and R&D into capability definitions: specs, target metrics, validation plan, in- vs out-of-scope definition, cost to deliver

  • Set priorities and dates with Engineering and Data Science; flag slippage early and make the trade-offs

  • Identify productization-gaps from delivery audits and analysis, and feed recurring ones back into the roadmap

2. Oversee product maturity and decide what we sell

  • Maintain the capability catalog: what is available now, in beta or on the roadmap, and what each can and cannot claim

  • Contribute to the final decision of when a capability is ready to sell (based on Data Science’s validation evidence) versus what is not-yet sellable in the pipeline, and communicate it internally

  • Oversee the scientific case for each capability: white papers, application notes, posters

3. Design how results reach partners

  • Design the reports, data packages and dashboards partners receive, and direct the engineers who build them

  • Own the deliverable contents: figures, statistical summaries, methods, limitations

  • Embed the approved claims and the QC checklist in every template, so Pharma Partnerships can produce a correct deliverable at scale

  • Keep templates current as the validated envelope changes, and pull or revise one when it no longer applies

What we're looking for

Must have

  • PhD or equivalent in cancer biology, pharmacology, biostatistics or computational biology

  • 8+ years in translational oncology, biomarker or diagnostics development, computational-biology platforms or preclinical CRO services, including 2+ owning a product roadmap

  • Technical depth: you read and understand production code, and can brief and review the work of engineers who build our reports and dashboards

  • You judge evidence: from a validation pack - back-tests, calibration, biomarker cutoffs -, you can state a claim the data supports and refuse the one it doesn't

  • You have experience working at the intersection of scientific and business departments within fast-growing companies

  • You know how pharma decides: you have seen proposals, SOWs and due-diligence questions, and know what a go/no-go decision needs from a prediction

  • Fluent in English

Nice to have

  • You have seen bespoke research work turned into something repeatable and sellable

  • Scientific authorship: Posters, talks, papers or white papers; a presence at AACR, ASCO, ESMO or SITC

  • Regulatory: exposure to regulated or quality-managed environments

  • Therapeutic or preclinical knowledge: ADC, immuno-oncology or targeted therapy; organoid or in-vitro pharmacology

  • Clinical-trial design or Trial statistics: adaptive designs, sample size, endpoints

  • Templated reporting: report-generation frameworks or web front-end

What we offer

  • Ownership: a product function to build from the ground up.

  • Team: an exceptional crew of clinicians, biologists, engineers and data scientists, most with a PhD.

title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) Freelance
description:
Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) 

Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

À propos de l'opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

  • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

  • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.

  • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

  • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

  • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

  • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

  • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

  • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

  • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

  • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

  • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

  • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

  • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

  • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

  • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

  • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.

  • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

  • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

  • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

  • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

  • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.

  • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.

  • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.

  • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.

  • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.

  • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

title: Senior Radiochemist

Transmutex is a Swiss company founded in 2019. Transmutex is currently advancing the HI-BEAM (High Intensity Breakthrough Engineering for Advanced Medicine) project, an ambitious programme to develop an industrial-scale facility for the reliable production of medical-grade Actinium-225 (Ac-225), a critical radionuclide for emerging targeted alpha therapies. 

Our team spans nuclear physics, engineering, software, radiochemistry, pharmaceutical and industrial development. Working with research labs and industrial partners worldwide, we are building the production capacity needed for the next generation of cancer treatments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the HI-BEAM project progresses from conceptual design into experimental validation, Transmutex is expanding its radiochemistry capability to translate established laboratory methods—supported by collaboration with leading international research institutes—into automated, reproducible, and commercially viable production processes.

We are seeking a Senior radiochemist to actively contribute to the technical design of Transmutex’ s radiochemistry process, in strong collaboration with renowned research labs. You will report to the Head of Extraction unit and be part of a small international team

You will primarily be based in Vernier, GE, with regular travel to Villigen, AG and to partner research labs in North America.

Process development:

  • Design and optimize radiochemical separation and purification.
  • Collaborate across teams to develop radiochemical processes and methodology.
  • Perform radiochemical and chemical analyses, including alpha and gamma spectrometry.
  • Track radiochemistry developments and adopt relevant innovations and best practices.

Industrialization and operations:

  • Develop the radiochemical process flowsheet, including unit operations, process parameters, material balances, cycle times and waste streams.
  • cale up and transfer laboratory processes to a robust and GMP-compliant production line.
  • Define process, equipment, utility, instrumentation and facility-interface requirements.
  • Support equipment selection, sizing, qualification, commissioning and process validation.
  • Develop operating procedures, batch records, control strategies and consumables requirements.
  • Prepare laboratory and production operations aligned with capacity and customer needs.
  • Train and mentor colleagues.

Compliance, quality, and safety:

  • Work with QA and Safety to ensure regulatory compliance and meet applicable standards
  • Implement and monitor safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS

The candidates we are looking for must have:

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Radiochemistry, Nuclear Chemistry or related field
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in radiochemistry.
  • Proven experience in radiochemical separation and purification with strong knowledge of actinide chemistry.
  • In-depth understanding of radiochemistry processes, equipment and tools.
  • Mastery of characterization, alpha or gamma spectrometry, ICP-MS, ICP-OES, liquid scintillation counting, or comparable analytical techniques.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of safety, radioprotection and GMP regulations and requirements. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to collaborate effectively with multiple internal and external stakeholders across disciplines.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
