ComfyUI workflow construction, debugging, model loading, node graph organization, and dependency management.

Practical prompt engineering for controlled output, not prompt decoration.

Image evaluation for realism, consistency, brand fit, and production usability.

Comfort with fast tool changes, incomplete documentation, broken nodes, model conflicts, and solving problems directly.

INDG has spent more than two decades building CGI, 3D, and visual production systems for global brands. Grip now orchestrates AI workflows and production-grade outputs across that same visual heritage.

title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations - Remote
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.


The Role

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

  • Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

  • Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

  • Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

  • Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.   

  • Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.

The Challenge

We are seeking researchers who:

  • See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

  • Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

  • Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

  • Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.


It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning

  • Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities

  • Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently

  • Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity

  • Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights

  • Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques

  • History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI


Ideal Researcher Profile

An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.



1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations

Mastery of Core Concepts

Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways

Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing

Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.


2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation

Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks

Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

Turning Theory into Practice

Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source

Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.


3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems

Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines

Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training

A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.


4. Hardware & Systems Understanding

Efficient Implementations at Scale

Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

Real-Time & On-Device Constraints

SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.

Architectural & Optimization Details

Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.


5. Rigorous Experimental Design

Controlled Comparisons & Ablations

Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.

Multifold Evaluation Metrics

From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.

Stress Tests & Edge Cases

Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities.



Summary

Overall, an ideal researcher in deep learning consistently demonstrates:

  • A solid grounding in theoretical and statistical principles

  • A talent for proposing and validating new algorithmic solutions

  • The capacity to orchestrate data pipelines that scale and reflect real-world diversity

  • Awareness of hardware constraints and system-level trade-offs for efficiency

  • Thorough and transparent experimental practices

These qualities surface across research on speech (Whisper, BASE TTS), language modeling (Scaling Laws, phi-3), specialized hardware (TPU, Transformers are SSMs), and new representation methods (VQ-VAE, FSQ, SoundStream). By balancing these attributes—rigorous math, innovative algorithms, large-scale data engineering, hardware-savvy optimizations, and reproducible experimentation—researchers can produce impactful, trustworthy advancements in foundational deep learning.




Foundational Papers

This job description was generated through analysis of the following papers:

  • Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (arXiv:2212.04356)

  • Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue (arXiv:2410.00037)

  • Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis (arXiv:2403.03206)

  • Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models (arXiv:2001.08361)

As one of the world's fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites - so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays - booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

Who we're looking for

Our strategic supply partners are among the most important relationships at Vio. These are large, sophisticated organisations - leading players in global travel - and the partnerships we build with them are nuanced, multi-layered, and carry significant commercial weight. Managing them well requires seniority, judgment, and genuine care for the relationship. We are looking for a senior Key Accounts Director to own these partnerships end-to-end and grow them for the long term.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you will personally manage and be solely accountable for a portfolio of strategic accounts - their commercial results, their relationship health, and their long-term trajectory. Your leverage comes from your relationships, your strategic thinking, and your ability to mobilise cross-functional partners inside Vio.

What you will do

Strategic Account Ownership

  • Own a portfolio of Vio's largest and most strategic supply accounts end-to-end as a single accountable individual, covering the full partnership lifecycle: commercial alignment, performance optimization, rate and distribution management, escalations, and growth

  • Be the voice of these accounts inside Vio: represent their perspective in strategic conversations across the company — including how we shape our supply strategy and evolve our partnerships over time — and ensure account considerations are reflected in decisions well beyond the day-to-day

  • Define and execute a dedicated growth plan per account: revenue targets, specific levers (feed expansion, rate improvements, exclusive deals, promotional campaigns), milestones, and regular progress reviews with the partner and internal stakeholders

  • Develop a deep understanding of each partner's business - their strategy, priorities, ways of working, and what success looks like for them - and use that understanding to build alignment and create outcomes that work for both sides

Relationship Building & Stakeholder Management

  • Build deep, multi-level, trust-based relationships across each account - from working teams to senior leadership - and act as the face of Vio to these partners

  • Conduct regular business reviews, executive meetings, and working sessions; represent Vio at industry events and in-person partner visits

  • Navigate sensitive conversations with excellent interpersonal judgment: knowing when to push, when to concede, and how to preserve the relationship while defending Vio's interests

  • Serve as the escalation point for anything concerning these accounts, internally and externally

Navigating Complex Partnerships

  • Manage multi-dimensional relationships where interests align in some areas and diverge in others - always finding the path that grows the shared business

  • Balance the interests of both sides thoughtfully: understand what matters most to each partner and build account strategies that respect the full context of the relationship

  • Exercise sound judgment on commercial sensitivity, information sharing, and contractual commitments while building genuine trust

  • Anticipate strategic shifts on the partner side (distribution policy changes, market moves, changing priorities) and prepare Vio's position before they materialise

Strategic & Commercial Growth

  • Think beyond the standard playbook: design out-of-the-box solutions, deal structures, and win/win constructs that grow the account where conventional levers are exhausted

  • Negotiate high-stakes commercial agreements - terms, overrides, exclusive and secret deals, tactical promotions, rate distribution rules, and SLAs - with sophisticated counterparts

  • Proactively initiate re-negotiations when performance data, market conditions, or competitive benchmarking reveal opportunities

  • Propose and run commercial experiments (pricing tests, promotional trials) with these partners, track results, and scale what works

Performance & Analytics

  • Monitor and act on account-level KPIs: revenue, margin, conversion, price competitiveness, availability, mapping coverage, and content quality

  • Identify root causes of underperformance and translate data into concrete commercial actions and partner conversations

  • Detect issues and opportunities early - before they impact revenue or the relationship

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Pricing, Meta, Connectivity/Integration, Finance, Analytics, Product, and Customer Support to deliver on account commitments

  • Ensure integration health for your accounts: connectivity stability, price accuracy, content completeness, and SLA compliance

  • Provide commercial input to product and pricing decisions affecting your accounts

Who you are

  • Extensive experience (10+ years) in travel - OTA, bedbank/wholesaler, hotel distribution or other adjacent vertical - including several years managing large, strategic accounts

  • A proven track record of growing key accounts through relationship depth and creative commercial solutions, not just account maintenance

  • Excellent relationship builder with outstanding interpersonal skills - able to earn trust quickly, read the room, and operate credibly with senior executives

  • Strategic thinker: you understand how large travel companies operate and can connect their strategy to Vio's opportunities

  • Experienced in navigating complex, high-stakes partnerships where interests don't always fully align - with the diplomacy and maturity to keep them healthy and growing

  • Strong negotiator with experience in complex, high-stakes commercial agreements

  • Executive presence internally as well as externally — comfortable contributing to company-level strategic discussions, not only account-level ones

  • Strong analytical skills - you ground every partner conversation and every proposal in data

  • A true individual contributor: self-directed, structured, accountable, and effective without a supporting team

  • A creative, out-of-the-box approach: you are not afraid to challenge the status quo - internally and with partners

  • Deep understanding of hotel distribution mechanics: rate types, net rates, dynamic pricing, rate fencing, distribution rules, margin structures, and MOR vs. agency models

Nice to Have

  • Existing senior-level network at major OTAs, bedbanks, or travel platforms

  • Experience with hotel connectivity (API/XML integrations) and metasearch economics

Why join us now?

  • We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of product features.

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide.

  • We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score.

  • We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

What we offer

  • A high-impact senior role with direct influence on Vio's most important commercial relationships

  • Exposure to - and ownership of - the largest strategic players in global travel supply

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture which promotes knowledge sharing, trust and transparency

  • A great compensation package, perks and benefits (including significant stock appreciation rights)

  • Flexible time off (take as many holidays as you need) and a chance to work remotely

  • You will be part of a highly international team that enjoys working, eating and playing together in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins with company events in Amsterdam and abroad

title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Description

We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.


Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.


Why join us?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
Still unsure about why joining us?
  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.
  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
Let’s make the invisible visible!


What will you do

  • Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.
  • Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.
  • Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.
  • Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.
  • For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.
  • Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.
  • Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.


What is expected of you

  • Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.
  • A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.
  • The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.

  • Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.

  • Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).
  • Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).
  • Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).
  • A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.

description:
About us

At CYCLE, we're redefining urban mobility for the people who keep cities moving: couriers, riders, and delivery pros. Our e-bike subscription service combines durable vehicles, fast repairs, and real support, everything riders need to stay on the road.
From Berlin to London, Vienna to Amsterdam, we operate in 200+ cities across Europe, providing thousands of riders with bikes built for work, not for show.
Our mission is simple: make last-mile delivery more reliable, affordable, and sustainable, one ride at a time. With every bike we deploy, we're helping build the backbone of smarter, greener cities.
Ride with us into the future - sustainable, efficient, and full speed ahead!


Your Mission

As Head of Supply Chain, you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will:

  • Own supply chain end to end: Purchasing, warehousing, stock keeping and outbound logistics across our European network, as one function with one owner. You ultimately ensure we have the right number of bikes, batteries and parts at the right time, the right place and the best price.
  • Oversee our assembly & refurbishment activities: Manage our assembly and refurbishment partners, own the bills of material for everything we build from purchased components as well as internal refurbishment within our locations.
  • Own the systems, not just the process: Take full responsibility for our ERP and warehouse management setup for all supply chain topics, from data model and master data through to daily execution – you will be the business owner to our software team and guide implementation.
  • Professionalize the structure: Design and implement the processes, controls and physical setup our growing operation needs, and then get your hands dirty making them real and ensuring your organization internalizes them.
  • Own the numbers behind the goods: You will guide the rest of the company on such topics as transfer prices, landed cost allocation and other supply-chain related financials, ensuring each business line's P&L is accurately reflecting parts consumption and asset usage – together with our Finance team.
  • Drive the agenda across teams: Set priorities, align Hardware, Finance and Tech behind them, and hold the line when it matters. 
  • Partner with the larger organization and understand your impact on them: All you do, you do with the end goal in mind to become the best friend of our Local and Country Operations and Sales teams, who all depend on your fulfillment excellence to grow and maintain their businesses.
  • Lead and grow your team: Build a supply chain organization that scales with us across markets.


Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for someone who has built structure inside a well-run company and is ready to build it again from scratch, with their sleeves rolled up. Ideally you bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience, of which at least 5 in a managerial supply chain or operations role.
  • Experience leading a team of at least 3 direct reports in a supply chain or operations-heavy function.
  • Structure from an established company: You have worked inside proper processes and systems and know what good looks like.
  • 0 to 1 experience: You have also built something from nothing in a smaller or fast-moving company or demonstrated you can excel in such a setting, and you are comfortable being scrappy when that is what the situation needs.
  • Commercial and financial fluency: Working capital optimization, inter-company transactions or product costing,  are all familiar territory for you.
  • Cross-functional communication: You can carry a topic across teams and drive it to a decision.
  • Ownership and a firm, professional attitude: You take the whole problem, not your part of it.
  • English at C1 level or above

Nice to have:
  • Hands-on experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP, ideally including experience in shaping or designing a system for supply chain topics rather than execution alone.
  • Background in bike, scooter, mobility or another hardware-heavy industry where physical goods move between internal as well as external locations.
  • German or Dutch


What you can expect from us


  • Exciting industry: You will work in the dynamic world of mobility, which is a constantly evolving sector.
  • Real impact: Your work improves the lives of many bike couriers.
  • Take on immediate responsibility: Start making a difference right away and implement your own ideas. Boredom? Not a chance!
  • Shape the future: As part of our growing start-up, you will help to shape tomorrow's mobility.
  • International team & Strong network: Work alongside motivated colleagues from all over the world. Teamwork is very important to us.
  • Fair conditions: We offer a stable employment with attractive salary, €50 HRmony voucher, a company e-bike, modern equipment and 28 days' holiday a year.


Diversity

At CYCLE, we believe diversity makes us stronger. No matter who you are, where you're from, or what makes you unique, you're welcome here.

title: Marketing Director (m/w/d)
description:
Introduction

Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you.

Exolaunch, headquartered in Berlin, Germany with offices in the U.S., France, and Japan, is a global leader in launch mission integration and deployment technologies for small satellites. With a decade of flight heritage and over 841 satellites launched across 49 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. Exolaunch fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.


Brand presence and consistent messaging are essential enablers of our success.  As the Marketing Director (m/w/d) at Exolaunch, you will serve as a core strategic leader driving our global marketing, brand presence, and multi-channel social media accounts, while exercising hands-on ownership of our public image, press relations, and executive communications.


We’re looking for a visionary marketing leader and creative storyteller with deep expertise in luxury branding, premium positioning, and high-impact copywriting. The ideal candidate brings an exceptional grasp of brand strategy and global communications, capable of converting complex technical achievements into compelling narratives for industry leaders, partners, and international media. As a senior strategist, you will lead brand governance, steer cross-functional marketing initiatives, and oversee data-driven performance analytics. You will be expected to quantify Return on Investment and Return on Effort across all campaigns to ensure Exolaunch remains top-of-mind in our industry. You will lead a small but powerful and passionate internal communications team and manage external PR agencies and advisors as needed.


Strategic Marketing & Brand Leadership:

You will define and execute our end-to-end global marketing strategy, ensuring consistency of brand identity across digital platforms and industry events. You will collaborate internally with all departments to translate technical innovation into flagship marketing campaigns while engaging externally with launch partners, customers, investors and other key stakeholders to solidify market awareness and top positioning.


Communications & Executive Media Relations:

You will lead execution of internal and external-facing communications activities, such as press releases, journalist inquiries, events (internal and external), and internal newsletters. This includes keeping company templates with boilerplate language, numbers, and figures current, fielding interview requests and coordinating conference and other public speaking engagements for staff, enforcing launch provider guidelines for external communications from our customers, and coordinating press releases intended for public release.


Please provide a portfolio of your previous work with your application. This is a full-time, 12 month contract, based in Berlin, with renewal option at end of contract.


Your mission

  • Execute an integrated communication strategy that aligns with the company's objectives and values. 

  • Serve as a company spokesperson and manage media relations, proactively seeking opportunities for media coverage and managing crisis communication as needed. Craft compelling messages that further refines Exolaunch’s brand voice, style, and tone.

  • Oversee and implement the creation and approval of press releases, articles, blog posts, social media content, and other communication materials. 

  • Provide direction on social graphics and digital campaigns through a passion for photography/videography/graphic design.

  • (Internal) Collaborate cross-functionally with departments such as engineering, mission management, and business development to ensure consistent messaging and alignment. 

  • (External) Collaborate with satellite customers, launch providers, graphic designers, internal technical personnel, and others to create and distribute compelling messaging.

  • Lead and support company and industry events including launch viewings, customer events, conferences, etc. in Europe, the US, and globally.

  • Build and nurture relationships with key stakeholders, including industry influencers, journalists, and partners. 

  • Monitor industry trends and competitor activities to identify communication opportunities and risks. 

  • Stay up-to-date and forecast social trends, capitalizing on interesting cultural moments and tying them into a cohesive social strategy for an inherently technical organization.


Your profile

  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive leadership experience in strategic marketing, global brand management, and high-level communications.

  • Proven expertise in luxury branding, premium product positioning, and hands-on brand ownership within high-tech, aerospace, or premium enterprise sectors.

  • Fluency and mastery of the English language with exceptional executive copywriting and storytelling capabilities.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field. Real-world experience may be substituted based on past performance.

  • Demonstrated track record of directing complex digital campaigns, media relations strategies, and high-profile global industry events.

  • Strong analytical capability to evaluate marketing ROI, campaign performance metrics, and market trends to drive business growth.

  • Practical understanding of online journalism, blogging, and social media

  • A grasp on vocabulary and concepts in the space and satellite industry, or can quickly learn them

  • A strong love for space/science/technology and willingness to learn the industry, inside and out


Why us?

We offer you:

  • Competitive compensation package tailored to your experience and responsibilities

  • Subsidies for lunch, mobility, and special occasions, depending on eligibility

  • Flexible working hours and a friendly, collaborative atmosphere

  • State-of-the-art office in the heart of Berlin at Potsdamer Platz

  • Access to an in-house fitness studio at the HQ

  • All necessary IT equipment and office tools to perform your role effectively

  • Complimentary drinks, snacks, and fresh fruit, plus a well-equipped office environment

  • Regular team gatherings, celebrations, and internal events

  • Office-based position in a friendly, collaborative atmosphere


How to apply

Please apply directly via our careers page and select the relevant position:

  • https://www.exolaunch.com/careers

Please note that applications via email will not be considered. To ensure your application is linked to the correct position in our recruitment system, please apply directly via our careers page. 

Due to the high volume of applications, our review process may take some time. While we carefully consider all profiles, we may not be able to provide an individual update at every stage of the process. We appreciate your patience and understanding.

Du verantwortest unsere organische Präsenz, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Post. Sivara ist eine Damen-Unterwäsche- und Umstandsmode-Brand mit über 120.000 Kundinnen, unsere Community redet viel mit uns, und genau da entsteht dein Content.

  • Du bespielst Instagram und TikTok mit Reels, Stories und Posts, sodass wir präsent sind.
  • Du produzierst und schneidest selbst: aus Creator-Material und eigenen Aufnahmen baust du Videos, die unser Produkt richtig in Szene setzen.

  • Du stehst selbst vor der Kamera: eine Story aus deinem Alltag, ein spontanes Video aus dem Lager, eine Ansage an die Community. Und du wirkst bei unseren Ad-Creatives mit, wenn wir dich brauchen.
  • Du sprichst die Voice-Over für unsere Ads ein.
  • Du betreust unsere Affiliate- und Deal-Partner, findest neue Partner und baust den Kanal mit aus.
  • Du entwickelst, wie unsere Kanäle klingen und aussehen, schaust dir an was funktioniert hat und was nicht, und planst den nächsten Monat danach.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Social Media Marketing oder in der Content-Produktion, idealerweise für eine Brand oder im E-Commerce.
  • Du schneidest selbst und sicher, mit CapCut, Premiere oder einem vergleichbaren Tool.
  • Du hast eine angenehme, natürliche Sprechstimme und Lust darauf, regelmäßig Voice-Over einzusprechen.
  • Du bist extrovertiert und stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera. In die Kamera sprechen, ins Mikro sprechen, dich in unseren Stories mit deinem Gesicht zeigen, ist für dich kein Problem.
  • Du erkennst Formate und Trends früh und probierst sie aus, statt darauf zu warten, dass jemand sie freigibt.
  • Du triffst im Community Management den richtigen Ton, freundlich und auf Augenhöhe, auch wenn eine Kundin genervt schreibt.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau, weil alles was du schreibst direkt bei unseren Kundinnen landet.
  • Du organisierst dich im Remote-Setup selbst und ziehst Themen durch, auch wenn niemand zuschaut.
  • Nice-to-have: erste Berührung mit Affiliate- oder Deal-Plattformen, Erfahrung im Verhandeln mit Creatorinnen und deren Managements.

Benefits

  • 100% Remote, du arbeitest, wo du willst.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich deinem Leben anpassen. Wir bewerten dich nach Leistung, nicht nach Anwesenheit.
  • Arzttermine, Workation und Ähnliches sind bei uns unkompliziert möglich, kurze Absprache reicht.
  • Flache Hierarchien.
  • Performance-Bonus für echte Ergebnisse.
  • Netzwerk: Sivara ist eng vernetzt mit den führenden D2C-Brands Deutschlands und tauscht sich täglich mit anderen E-Commerce-Brands im 8- bis 9-stelligen Bereich aus. Du bekommst Einblicke und Kontakte, die du dir sonst über Jahre aufbauen müsstest.

Bis hier durch? Dann sind wir vielleicht dein Match.

Schick mir gerne ein kurzes, ungezwungenes Anschreiben per du. Was hast du bisher gemacht, welche Kanäle oder Accounts hast du selbst bespielt, was war dein bestes Video und warum hat es funktioniert, ab wann hättest du Lust, etc.

Ich freu mich von dir zu hören!

Beste Grüße
Kacper

title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer - Hydris - Golang (d/f/m)
description:
New Challenge

About Us 
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a Germany-based DefenseTech company with offices in Berlin and Munich. We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority — automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products – Hydris – the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it. 

You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving. 

The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified.

What you'll do
Core engine development

  • Design and build the systems that power Hydris.
  • Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day.
  • Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously.
Protocol and integration architecture
  • Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris.
  • Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden.
  • Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems.
  • Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained.
  • Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins/integrations to Hydris.
Distributed systems
  • Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments.
  • Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links.
  • Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained.
Technical leadership
  • Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product.
  • Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion.
  • Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs.

You should apply if you
  • Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience.
  • Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user.
  • Have well-formed views about API design and protocol evolution, informed by experience maintaining APIs that other people depend on.
  • Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical decisions, at scale.
  • Are interested in contributing to European military, maritime, and critical infrastructure defence systems.
  • Write clearly and communicate architectural decisions in a way that survives beyond the conversation where they were made. 
  • Working language is English. German is not required.
You'd be a great fit with
  • Experience with geospatial systems, sensor fusion, or track management.
  • Familiarity with defense or ISR data standards like CoT/TAK, ASTERIX, SAPIENT, MIL-STD-2525.
  • Background in networking, mesh architectures, or systems designed for contested or degraded communication environments.
  • Experience working on developer-facing open-source infrastructure where adoption depends on the quality of the API and documentation.

We Offer
  • Remote work anywhere in Germany, or hybrid/on-site in Berlin or Munich if you're already based there and prefer an office.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership, a flat structure, and real input into technical direction.
  • Annual €1500 Learning & development budget (available after probation).
  • Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
  • 30 days of paid time off.
Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

title: Senior Product Manager - Hardware & Edge AI (d/f/m)
description:

About Us
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a defence technology company with offices in Berlin and Munich, and a trusted partner of the German Armed Forces. Our customers field sensors, drones and C2 systems from many vendors that were never built to work together. We build Hydris, an orchestration layer that integrates the systems they already field, and the ones they'll add next, into one picture operators can act on across defence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Hydris runs at the edge, keeps working when the link drops, and its core is open source under Apache 2.0.

As Senior Product Manager for Mission Devices, you'll own the hardware that puts Hydris in the field. 

You'll work end-to-end, from discovery with operators through hardware build cycles to fielded units, and you'll decide what gets built rather than work through someone else's backlog. The bar is concrete: devices that run for months off-grid in contested RF environments.

What you'll do
Discovery and requirements

  • Spend time with end users in their operating environment to understand their workflows in depth, not just their stated requirements.
  • Validate assumptions about value, usability, feasibility and viability through prototypes, bench tests and field trials before committing to hardware fabrication.
  • Analyze contractual specifications with Program Managers, separating firm constraints from areas where there's room for the best technical solution.
Roadmap and delivery
  • Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap aligned to hardware build cycles (EVT/DVT/PVT), firmware releases and OTA update pipelines.
  • Define requirements and field metrics for each device, including detection performance, energy efficiency, mission endurance and SWaP, and make the trade-offs between them.
  • Prioritize investment across the device family, deciding where to extend existing devices and where a new one is needed.
Systems and interoperability
  • Make sure devices integrate with Hydris as and interoperate with third-party systems through industry standards and protocols.
  • Design provisioning, commissioning and deployment workflows that are simple and reliable in the field.
  • Investigate issues that span hardware, firmware and communications, and work with engineering to resolve them.
Collaboration
  • Act as the main source of product context and the product's champion, making sure the team, leadership and customers understand what we're building and why.
  • Work in a product trio with engineering (hardware and ML) and design. 
  • Partner with Program and Capture Managers to keep the product vision aligned with contractual commitments.
  • Write clear PRDs and decision records, and mentor teammates on discovery practice and hardware–software trade-offs.

You should apply if you have
  • 5+ years of product management experience with hardware–software products, for example in embedded systems, IoT, robotics, defence systems or edge AI.
  • Experience taking a connected hardware product from EVT/DVT through production into operational use, including in-field updates.
  • Experience running product development end to end, from discovery to engineering-ready work, and the ability to adapt to however a team works.

  • Clear communication with hardware engineers, ML researchers and operators alike.
  • Motivation to contribute to European security and sovereignty.
  • Willingness to travel regularly to military exercises, test ranges and customer sites in Germany and NATO partner countries, sometimes in demanding field conditions.
  • Eligibility for German security clearance (SÜ2).
  • Fluency in German and English (C1 or higher).
You'd be a particularly great fit with
  • A degree in electrical, mechanical or systems engineering, robotics or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience bringing hardware products from prototype to production.
  • Experience in military, public safety or other mission-critical operational environments.
  • Exposure to sensor fusion, mesh networking or degraded RF environments, including familiarity with interoperability standards such as Cursor on Target, SAPIENT, ONVIF or ASTERIX.

We Offer

Make sure UK Leasing always has the best-priced, best-covered deals in the market, so our sales team can draw more leads and convert more of them. This means owning the overall competitiveness of our marketplace, the deals every partner lists on it as well as Leasey's own, not just our own broker's position. You are the pricing engine behind the offer set: you find where we are missing competitive supply, own the ratebooks that power the marketplace, keep pricing accurate day to day, and guide Procurement and the Marketplace commercial team on where to find deals and at what price.

  • Analyse funder ratebooks and the Carwow marketplace to identify demand-supply whitespace, and guide the Procurement team on where to focus their supply-finding and at what price points.

  • Act as the in-office pricing expert and advisor to Procurement when they uncover supply opportunities, such as dealer finance deals or commitment batches.

  • Work with the Marketplace commercial team to make sure we are sourcing the best supply from our broker partners, using the whitespace and competitiveness analysis to steer what we ask partners for.

  • High attention to detail and a bias for accuracy, with the discipline to own a daily operational process where errors are visible to Sales and customers.

  • Commercially minded and confident advising a Procurement team, able to turn analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Understanding of how marketplaces work, including the interplay of demand and supply liquidity (desirable).

title: Director, GTM & Revenue Operations
description:
THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing, whether you are looking to buy, sell or lease. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. Over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

WHY JOIN US?

We are winners of the prestigious Culture 100 award that recognises the most loved and happiest tech companies to work for! We have just raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm Bessemer Venture Partners (an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify) to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 600 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in!


THE ROLE

This is a director role running the operating engine behind our commercial teams. Carwow sells cars in two ways: Sell My Car, where drivers sell their car to dealers, and Get Your Car, where they buy or lease their next one. As Director, GTM & Revenue Operations you own the operating model those commercial teams run on: the go-to-market process, the enablement and quality that get people productive, the systems they work in (Salesforce and the wider commercial tech stack), the analytics that forecast the commercial number, and the programme management that lands cross-functional change. The function covers five areas: GTM Operations, Sales Enablement, Tooling & Platform, Rev-Ops Analytics and Program Management. You report to the VP, Marketplace Operations and sit close to both the numbers and the commercial teams you serve. You make the commercial motion work; the commercial teams own the selling and the relationships.

This is a builder's role as much as a running one. You inherit a team of three (programme management, sales enablement and platform) and a clear mandate to grow the function to what the business needs. Shaping and hiring that team, and making the case for it, is central to the job. The commercial org has recently brought its Sell My Car and Get Your Car teams into a single account-management function serving one dealer network, so you'll run one operating model across both products (a unified Salesforce, aligned targets and comp, consistent enablement and quality) and get the last of that integration to steady state. The function has already moved real numbers here, reworking the sales process, standing up sales-engagement tooling and sharpening enablement, and your job is to take that further.

You own the operating model, process, enablement, the systems requirement and the forecast. The commercial organisation owns the relationships, the selling and delivery against the number. You design the targets, compensation and territory structures with commercial leadership and you shape decisions through the strength of the operating case. In your first year, success looks like a forecast that's trusted and accurate, new hires productive faster, a consistent quality bar across the combined team, and the platform and process the org runs on every day.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

You will own the commercial operating model and the team that runs it, working hand in glove with the commercial organisation, Workforce Management, the trading leads, and the analytics and data teams that support the whole function.

  • Own GTM operations: define the go-to-market playbook, pipeline and commercial process across both marketplaces, and, with commercial leadership, design the targets, compensation and territory / account structures that tie individual attainment to the business outcome. Own capacity and headcount planning with Workforce Management.

  • Own sales enablement and quality: build the onboarding and ramp-to-productivity structures, a standard readiness sign-off, org-wide QA and calibration, and ongoing L&D for both individual contributors and leaders, so new hires get productive faster and quality holds across the organisation.

  • Own the requirements for the commercial systems and tooling: direct Salesforce as the commercial system of record, owning the process and workflow design, prioritisation and the roadmap to bring the whole commercial org onto one platform, plus the sales-engagement and automation tooling (e.g. Groove), AI-assisted workflows and the performance dashboards the teams run on. You own the requirement and how the commercial org runs on the platform; the platform itself, its build and administration, sits with the tech org, who you partner with and direct.

  • Own revenue-operations analytics and forecasting: produce a forward-looking commercial forecast that feeds trading and reconciles to Finance's P&L view, own the operational reporting that diagnoses what the volume and operational teams are driving into the number, and provide the evidence base behind comp and performance decisions. You own the operational read and set the requirement; you partner with Finance and the central analytics and data teams, who own the build.

  • Own program management: run the commercial PMO, from end-to-end discovery and sizing of new initiatives through governance (charters, RACI, risk and impact), so cross-functional commercial programmes land on time with clear ownership.

  • Build the function: shape and hire the team the function needs across the five areas, from a starting base of three, and make the case for the investment. Run the combined Sell My Car and Get Your Car commercial operation as one, a single dealer view, one operating model, and consistent process across both products.

  • Get more out of the team with AI and automation: mature how the commercial org operates with AI-first tooling and automation, so manual workflows disappear and the org gets the answer without a person in the loop.

  • Feed the operating rhythm: own the commercial-motion input into the weekly operating cadence and the read up to Finance, trading and the CEO, with a clean, leadership-ready view of where the pipeline sits and where it is heading.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

Please note: We know that no candidate will be a perfect match for everything here, so please apply if you're close to the brief. If you meet most of the essentials, we'd like to hear from you.

The essentials:

  • A track record of leading a revenue-operations, commercial-operations or GTM-operations function at scale, in a marketplace, growth or B2B sales context

  • Breadth across the operating model: you've owned, or closely partnered on, most of GTM process, enablement, commercial systems and analytics, and you understand how they fit together

  • Strong CRM fluency with Salesforce as a system of record: you can set the requirements, shape the data model and process, and direct a platform team, not just keep it clean

  • Commercial process and incentive design: targets, compensation, territory and capacity planning tied to business outcomes

  • A people leader and builder: you've grown a multi-disciplinary team from a small base, hired well, and set a clear bar

  • Analytical and data-fluent: comfortable in a forecast and a pipeline model, and drawing honest conclusions from the numbers

How you'll work (we'll explore these in interview):

  • Fluent and curious with AI: you use it to work faster and help a team adopt it

  • Comfortable running a cross-functional PMO, with charters, RACI and clear risk management

  • Credible with senior stakeholders: you make a well-evidenced case and hold it under challenge, and you influence across teams you don't own

  • Self-directed: you turn an ambiguous problem into a plan, with a bias for action

  • Intellectually honest: you surface the hard truth early rather than the comfortable answer late

Nice to have:

title: Account Manager
description:
Mission

Gorilla is the margin intelligence platform for energy retailers. We help some of the largest energy companies in UK, Europe, the US, and Australia understand where they make and lose money, from portfolio level down to individual customer contracts.

We are entering a phase where protecting and growing our existing customer base matters as much as winning new logos. Our annual renewals represent millions in recurring revenue, and every one of them is an opportunity to deepen the relationship, expand into new modules, and prove the compounding value of our platform.

About the Role

You'll own the full commercial lifecycle of Gorilla's existing customer accounts - renewals, pricing, commercial strategy, and expansion - across a portfolio of Enterprise and Strategic accounts, primarily UK-based, with accounts also across Europe, the United States and Australia. This is a farmer role, not a hunter role: you're not chasing new logos, you're running 6–12 months ahead of every renewal, building the pricing and expansion strategy for each account, and turning retention into growth. There's no fixed playbook here.Every account sits on its own pricing history, so the role calls for real commercial creativity, not just process execution. You'll own a book of roughly £3-4m of annual renewals, measured on renewed ARR and expansion revenue from day one. Today this work sits with the CSM and the exec team on top of everything else.This hire gives our existing customers the dedicated commercial attention they deserve and frees leadership to focus on new business.

You'll own renewal negotiations, pricing and packaging, contract amendments, upsell strategy, and commercial QBR content, working closely with our Customer Success Manager, who owns product adoption and day-to-day customer engagement. When usage data shows a customer nearing capacity, you build the upgrade case. When adoption is strong, you open the expansion conversation. When there's risk, you shape the retention strategy. You turn commercial signals into growth.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full commercial renewal process across our Enterprise and Strategic accounts, maintaining a clear, accurately forecasted pipeline of timing, risk, and expected ARR.

  • Build a bespoke commercial strategy for each account — using usage data, market context, and each customer's pricing history to develop compelling business cases for additional modules and deeper integration.

  • Act on signals surfaced by the Customer Success Manager, building the expansion case commercially before renewal conversations start.

  • Map and manage multi-stakeholder accounts, from economic buyer to day-to-day champion, and know how to navigate the politics between them.

  • Lead the commercial component of QBRs and strategic reviews, translating adoption data into a value narrative and handle the harder conversations, including contract amendments, pricing corrections, and telling a customer why a price is going up.

  • Partner with our energy consultants and solution consulting team to quantify expansion value and build credible ROI narratives for customer stakeholders.

  • Feed customer and market insight back into Product and Marketing: what customers value, what they're asking for, and where the energy market is heading.

What You'll Bring

  • Real commercial creativity - the ability to build a bespoke pricing and expansion case, including quantification of the past and extrapolation of the future ROI and, from a blank page for every account, rather than executing a standard playbook. This is the single most important trait for this role.

  • Proven ownership of enterprise SaaS renewals and expansion, with six-figure+ deal sizes, measured on retained and expanded ARR; managed through relationships with 6-10 people buying committees at various layers of the customer’s organisation.

  • A strategic eye for growth levers others miss, whether that's a regulatory shift creating urgency, a new business unit that needs what we offer, or a competitor stumble that opens a door.

  • Strong negotiation instincts, equally comfortable presenting to a VP of Commercial or holding firm with a sophisticated procurement team.

  • Experience in energy, utilities, or another complex regulated vertical is a strong advantage. Our customers are energy leaders, portfolio managers and pricing leaders who expect their vendors to understand their world. If you don't come from energy, you can show you'll get there fast.

  • Familiarity with enterprise sales methodologies - we useMEDDPICC for deal scoring.

  • Structured and proactive by nature, working ahead of renewal dates rather than reacting to them.

What's in it for you

  • Flexible ways of working – We’re a hybrid-first company, with offices designed for collaboration and connection. Where there isn’t a Gorilla office nearby or regular travel to an office isn’t practical, we support remote working. From day one, you'll be equipped with the best laptop for your role, so you have everything you need to do your best work.

  • At Gorilla, we don't just watch the energy transition happen, we help make it viable. We build the intelligence layer that lets energy retailers see, steer, and protect their margins, giving them the financial clarity and operational room to invest confidently in renewables, storage, and flexibility. It's serious work with real impact on a cleaner energy system, and we have some fun along the way.

  • Core Benefits - Wherever your location, you can expect a generous PTO allowance and health insurance coverage.

  • At Gorilla, you'll work with genuinely sharp people on hard problems that matter. As we build the category leader in Energy Margin Intelligence, there's real room to leave your mark and grow your scope alongside the company. Lifelong learning is part of our DNA, and we care about your individual dreams and ambitions, beyond just work.

  • International Travel: We host Gorilla Company-Wide Gatherings where we all get a chance to see each other in real life. Past locations have included Belgium, Portugal, the Netherlands, and Spain.

title: People Director
description:
Zibber groeit. In Nederland, België en Duitsland, en met verdere Europese ambities. Dat vraagt om een People Director die zorgt dat onze organisatie kan meegroeien: met stevige & mensgerichte leiders, de juiste mensen op de juiste plek, een high-performance cultuur en People-processen die ons helpen om beter en sneller te werken.

We zoeken een strategische en hands-on People leader die gelooft dat duurzame groei begint bij mensen. Iemand die oog heeft voor wat onze collega's en leiders nodig hebben om met Zibber mee te groeien, zich te ontwikkelen én met plezier goed werk te kunnen doen. Je verbindt die menselijke kant aan onze bedrijfsstrategie en kijkt verder dan wat vandaag nodig is. Zo bouw je aan de organisatie die Zibber de komende drie tot vijf jaar nodig heeft, zonder het ondernemerschap, de persoonlijke aandacht en de energie kwijt te raken die ons succesvol hebben gemaakt.

Over Zibber

Zibber helpt vastgoedprofessionals zoals makelaars, bedrijfsmakelaars, woningcorporaties en property managers om woningen en panden beter, sneller en professioneler in de markt te zetten. Dat doen we met vastgoedfotografie, video, plattegronden, 3D-laserscanning en meetrapporten.

Onze kracht zit in de combinatie van mensen, operatie en technologie. Met ons eigen platform MyZibber digitaliseren en automatiseren we een groot deel van het proces voor onze klanten. Technologie, data en AI spelen daarbij een steeds grotere rol in hoe we werken en groeien.

Met circa 250 collega's in Nederland, België en Duitsland zijn we marktleider in vastgoedmedia. Het overgrote deel van onze mensen werkt in het veld: bijna 200 collega's leveren dagelijks op locatie bij onze klanten. We zijn PE-backed en werken gericht op groei, professionalisering, schaalbaarheid en internationale expansie. People & Culture speelt daarin een sleutelrol.

De rol

Als People Director ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor People & Culture over heel Zibber: Nederland, België en Duitsland. Je bent onderdeel van het managementteam en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de CEO. De volgende fase vraagt om een grotere en meer strategische rol. 

Je belangrijkste opdracht is ervoor te zorgen dat Zibber én onze mensen klaar zijn voor de volgende groeifase. Je bouwt aan een omgeving waarin collega's zich gezien voelen, zich kunnen ontwikkelen en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Je helpt leiders om hun teams daarin mee te nemen en vertaalt onze bedrijfsstrategie naar een heldere People-agenda, zodat mensen, organisatie en ambities samen kunnen groeien.

Wat deze rol anders maakt dan een standaard People-rol: onze vraag is seizoensgebonden en beweegt mee met de woningmarkt, en onze organisatie is grotendeels een verspreide buitendienst. Capaciteitsplanning, de bijbehorende kostencyclus en on- en offboarding op grote schaal vormen de kern van je werk.

Je focus ligt op vier gebieden:

1.Organisatie en leiderschap

  • Je bent een gelijkwaardige en onafhankelijke gesprekspartner voor de CEO, het MT en de leidinggevenden op organisatiestructuur, leiderschap, verandering en organisatie-effectiviteit.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat structuur, rollen, governance en leiderschap de strategie ondersteunen, zodat de organisatie sneller en effectiever resultaten behaalt.

  • Je ontwikkelt de leiderschapscultuur verder en helpt managers sterke teams bouwen die groeien en leveren.

  • Je brengt een helder People-perspectief in, stelt vragen die de organisatie verder helpen en maakt met de board en het MT duidelijke keuzes.

  • Je onderhoudt de relatie met de medezeggenschap in Nederland, België en Duitsland en betrekt hen tijdig en constructief bij verandering.

2. Buitendienst, performance en talent

  • Je professionaliseert workforce planning voor een seizoensgebonden, verspreide buitendienst: capaciteitsplanning, high-volume recruitment, on- en offboarding op grote schaal en retentie in het veld.

  • Je stuurt actief op de kostenkant van die cyclus en maakt de formatie- en kostenimpact van People-beslissingen inzichtelijk.

  • Je zorgt voor gezond, veilig en duurzaam werken in het veld, en voor een goed mobiliteits- en leasevlootbeleid voor de buitendienst.

  • Je bouwt aan een cultuur waarin mensen weten wat er van hen verwacht wordt, elkaar feedback geven en ruimte krijgen om te groeien.

  • Je professionaliseert performance management, talentmanagement, succession planning en leiderschapsontwikkeling.

  • Je zorgt voor een sterke employee experience, een omgeving waarin mensen graag werken én goed presteren.

3. Schaalbare en toekomstbestendige People-infrastructuur

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat People-processen, systemen en governance eenvoudig, efficiënt en schaalbaar zijn.

  • Je richt onze flexibele schil en buitendienst arbeidsrechtelijk robuust en toekomstbestendig in, inclusief kwalificatievraagstukken rondom zelfstandigheid. Je voert hierop de regie en werkt samen met gespecialiseerde arbeidsrechtelijke adviseurs in de drie landen.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor compensation & benefits, arbeidsvoorwaarden en het People-budget.

  • Je maakt People-data inzichtelijk en gebruikt analytics voor betere beslissingen over formatie, verloop, engagement, recruitment en performance.

  • Je zet HR-tech, AI en automation slim in om de People-organisatie effectiever en schaalbaarder te maken.

4. Cultuur en change

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat Happiness, Keep it Simple en Get it Done zichtbaar blijven in hoe we werken, leidinggeven en besluiten nemen. Juist ook als de organisatie groter en internationaler wordt.

  • Je helpt de organisatie professionaliseren zonder onnodige bureaucratie.

  • Bij groei, integraties en veranderingen help je bewust bouwen aan één Zibber: met dezelfde uitgangspunten voor cultuur en leiderschap, maar met ruimte voor wat lokaal anders moet.

  • Je bouwt samen met Marketing aan onze employer value proposition en employer branding, voor twee verschillende arbeidsmarkten: de buitendienst en het kantoor- en technologietalent.

  • Je stuurt het People-team aan, ontwikkelt het verder en zorgt voor duidelijke rollen, eigenaarschap en hoge kwaliteit.

Leiderschap bij Zibber

Als People Director geef je zelf het voorbeeld. Je maakt complexiteit simpel, creëert duidelijkheid en geeft mensen eigenaarschap. Je combineert hoge standaarden met oprechte aandacht voor mensen.

Je creëert ruimte voor verschillende perspectieven en durft besluiten te nemen wanneer dat nodig is. Je brengt een onafhankelijk perspectief in, luistert naar andere inzichten en spreekt je uit wanneer dat nodig is. Je kijkt verder dan People & Culture, doorbreekt silo's en neemt met het MT verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat van Zibber als geheel.

Strategisch wanneer het kan. Handen uit de mouwen wanneer het moet.

Wat je krijgt

Je komt terecht in een club die hard werkt en net zo hard lacht. Happiness is niet voor niets een van onze kernwaarden: we nemen het werk serieus en onszelf wat minder. Verder krijg je:

  • Een ambitieus en informeel team met veel energie en humor, waar successen worden gevierd en een goede grap nooit ver weg is.

  • Een sleutelpositie op directieniveau binnen een snelgroeiende internationale organisatie, met een plek in het MT en directe samenwerking met de CEO.

  • Volledige ownership over de People & Culture-agenda en directe invloed op hoe Zibber zich de komende jaren organiseert.

  • Korte lijnen, snelle besluitvorming en veel verantwoordelijkheid, in een PE-backed omgeving met ambitie en duidelijke groeidoelen.

  • De ruimte om technologie, data, AI en automation actief in te zetten binnen People & Culture.

  • Een vast salaris tussen €7.000 en €8.500 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, aangevuld met een bonus gekoppeld aan People- en bedrijfsresultaten.

  • Een keuzebudget voor extra vakantiedagen of extra pensioeninleg.

  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding voor de dagen dat je thuis werkt.


Dit is een dynamische, energieke en veelzijdige rol met veel impact.

Herken je jezelf in minimaal 80% van onderstaande? Reageer dan zeker. Bijna niemand vinkt elk punt af, en dat verwachten we ook niet. We kijken naar wie je bent, wat je meebrengt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien. Twijfel je? Doe het gewoon. We horen graag van je.

  • Multi-country op MT-niveau.  Je bent eerder eindverantwoordelijk geweest voor People in een organisatie actief in meerdere landen, met aantoonbare ervaring in internationaal arbeidsrecht.

  • Bewezen ervaringsniveau.  Langdurige HR-ervaring, waarvan meerdere jaren eindverantwoordelijk, met bewezen functioneren op MT- of directieniveau en directe rapportage aan een CEO.

  • Dynamische organisatie.  Je hebt gewerkt in een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie en je snapt hoe hoog tempo, verandering en schaal doorwerken op mensen, structuur en cultuur.

  • Flexibele schil & inzet.  Je hebt ervaring met het correct en toekomstbestendig inrichten van een flexibele schil of buitendienst, inclusief kwalificatievraagstukken rondom zelfstandigheid.

  • Datagedreven en financieel onderlegd.  Je vertaalt People-beslissingen naar impact op de business en onderbouwt die met cijfers.

  • Visie op performance en talent.  Je hebt een duidelijke visie op performance management, leiderschapsontwikkeling en talentmanagement, en weet die om te zetten in de praktijk.

  • Onafhankelijk en verbindend.  Je bent een stevige sparringpartner voor CEO en MT die een eigen standpunt inbrengt, je leest de organisatie en draagt de cultuur op een manier die verder gaat dan proces en structuur. Daarnaast weet je wat hands-on werken betekent en ben je in staat om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en zaken op te pakken.

  • Taal. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Sterke pre

  • Ervaring in een PE-backed omgeving, 

  • Ervaring met professionalisering, integraties en overnames.

  • Ervaring met HR-tech, AI en automation binnen People.

  • Ervaring met buitendienst op schaal. Inclusief gedistribueerde populatie geleid, met high-volume recruitment, on- en offboarding, retentie en de seizoensdynamiek.

Ga jij People & Culture bij Zibber naar de volgende fase brengen?

We zoeken een People Director die bouwt aan een schaalbare organisatie, sterk leiderschap en een cultuur waarin mensen en performance allebei serieus worden genomen.

title: Maintenance Lead
description:
Een fabriek waar volop wordt geïnvesteerd in techniek en waar continu verbeteren onderdeel is van de dagelijkse praktijk. Als Maintenance Lead krijg je de ruimte om niet alleen technische problemen op te lossen, maar vooral te zorgen dat we ze steeds beter vóór zijn.
