Als Maintenance Lead werk je aan één belangrijk doel: onze installaties en productielijnen steeds betrouwbaarder laten presteren.

Je onderzoekt complexe en terugkerende storingen, analyseert oorzaken en bepaalt wat nodig is om herhaling te voorkomen. Daarbij ben je veel op de productievloer te vinden en werk je nauw samen met operators, Equipment Owners, Line Leads en collega's binnen de technische organisatie.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • het analyseren en structureel oplossen van complexe en terugkerende storingen;

  • het realiseren van technische verbeteringen en deze borgen in onderhoudsplannen en standaarden;

  • het begeleiden en technisch verder ontwikkelen van operators en Equipment Owners;

  • het bijdragen aan technische projecten, bijvoorbeeld als Startup Lead of projectlid.

We werken hierbij volgens ons Integrated Work System (IWS), waarmee we continu verbeteren onderdeel maken van onze dagelijkse manier van werken.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Een technische functie met verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte voor eigen initiatief en volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Daarnaast krijg je:

Jouw ingrediënten

title: Senior Software Engineer - Confidential Computing & Runtime Security (Eindhoven)
description:
About Fortanix:  

In today's world, where data spreads across various clouds and devices, traditional security measures aren't enough. Businesses need a dynamic approach to defend against constant cyber threats and ensure agile data security. Fortanix leads the way in data-centric cybersecurity for hybrid multicloud environments, using advanced cryptography, encryption, and confidential AI solutions.   

As data breaches become more frequent and traditional defenses fall short, we focus on data exposure management to keep your information safe. Our unified data security platform addresses vulnerabilities in hybrid multicloud environments, defends against threats, and makes it easier to discover, assess, and fix data exposure risks. Whether implementing a Zero Trust model or preparing for the post-quantum computing era, we help businesses worldwide protect their most sensitive data, wherever it is.  

Our commitment to solving the world’s toughest data security challenges has earned Fortanix multiple Cybersecurity Excellence and Innovation Awards, as well as recognition from industry giants such as Nvidia, Microsoft, Intel, ServiceNow, and Snowflake.  

Our team includes industry leaders and cryptography experts, creating a culture of trust, innovation and collaboration where every voice is valued. Recognized as a Great Place to Work, we're looking for passionate individuals to help us shape the future of data security and work towards a safer digital future. 

Requirements

At the intersection of systems engineering, security, and cryptography, we're building technology that helps organizations protect their most sensitive data—even while it's actively being processed. If you're passionate about low-level software, secure systems, and solving complex technical challenges, this is an opportunity to work on some of the most advanced security problems in the industry. 

As a Senior Software Engineer on our Runtime Encryption team, you'll help shape the future of confidential computing by developing the tools, SDKs, and platform capabilities that enable secure execution environments. You'll work across the software stack—from applications and runtimes down to the operating system and hardware layers—while collaborating with a team of engineers pushing the boundaries of data protection. 

This role offers the chance to work on cutting-edge technologies that protect data in use, at rest, and in transit, while contributing to products used by organizations around the world to secure their most critical workloads. 

Location 

We strongly prefer candidates who are within commuting distance of our Eindhoven, Netherlands office and are excited to work in a hybrid environment. For exceptional candidates with deep domain expertise in confidential computing, systems security, or low-level software engineering, remote work may be considered. 

 

What you’ll do (Duties and Responsibilities):  

  • Develop tools and SDKs for confidential computing platforms.  
  • Support other teams within Fortanix to use tools related to confidential computing platforms developed internally  
  • Design, develop, and implement high-quality software solutions that meet security and performance standards.  
  • Investigate and resolve complex issues spanning application, runtime, kernel, and platform layers. 
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends in security and confidential computing.  
  • Conduct code reviews, ensure best practices in software development, and maintain high standards of code quality.  
  • Drive the adoption of new tools, methodologies, and processes to improve development efficiency and product quality. 

 

What you’ll need (Basic Qualifications) 

  • A passion for systems programming and low-level software development, particularly in x86-based environments. 
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and an appreciation for modern programming languages and abstractions, particularly Rust. 
  • Solid understanding of Linux kernel and operating system fundamentals.  
  • A desire to work within a small, highly collaborative team and help grow its technical expertise and impact. 
  • At least 3-5 years of hands-on experience with C/C++ or Rust  
  • Bachelor or Master in Computer Science, Information Security or related field 
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively.  
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts.  

 

Preferred Technical And Professional Expertise  

  • Experience with trusted execution environments or confidential computing technologies. 
  • Knowledge of rust compiler, virtualization, or cloud infrastructure. 
  • Familiarity with low-level security concepts, attack mitigations, and secure systems design, along with a desire to deepen expertise in these areas. 
  • Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies, including CI/CD, Agile, and DevOps.   
  • Contributions to open-source projects. 

Benefits

  • We offer a competitive salary and equity package
  • 40 hours of Volunteer Time Off/year
  • The opportunity to redefine cloud computing in a friendly, collaborative work environment.  

Fortanix is an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other status. If you’re interested in working in a fast growing, exciting working environment – we encourage you to apply!

At Feather, we're building insurance that actually matters to our customers. It rests on three principles: a fully digital experience, modern and flexible plans, and reliable human support. And because we build it all for expats living abroad, we're a genuinely different kind of insurer.

  • Flexible remote work policy. We offer a remote-first work environment, hiring across Europe via an Employer of Record. We host company retreats, team dinners, and meetups to spend in-person time together.


What you bring to the table

  • You have hands-on experience handling health claims across borders or internationally.
  • You are familiar with medical coding and provider billing.
  • You have an instinct for automation and AI tooling, and you use it daily.

Über Nelly

Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann. Unsere All-In-One Plattform verwandelt chaotische administrative Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Arbeitsabläufe, von der Patientenbetreuung über die Abrechnung bis hin zu Zahlungen der nächsten Generation. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben.

Warum? Europa ist mit einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachkräften konfrontiert. Wenn wir die Arbeitsweise von Praxen nicht überdenken, wird das System nicht mithalten können. Mit unserer Series B Finanzierung in Höhe von über 50 Millionen Euro von Weltklasse-Investoren setzen wir unsere Vision in die Tat um.

Was dich erwartet: Wir arbeiten mit dem besten Team und geben gemeinsam jeden Tag alles. Wir setzen auf Talent Density, weil außergewöhnliche Menschen alle um sie herum besser machen. Bei Nelly bewegen wir uns schnell und erwarten, dass alle mithalten. Stillstand ist keine Option, deshalb investieren wir stark in Weiterentwicklung. KI ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have. Wir erwarten, dass du sie täglich nutzt und geben dir alle Möglichkeiten, dies zu tun. Du bekommst Vertrauen und Verantwortung, dafür erwarten wir, dass du Dinge ansprichst, auch wenn es unbequem ist.

Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du bist die erste Stimme, die potenzielle Nelly-Kund:innen von uns hören – und die Person, die entscheidet, welche Leads es bis zur Demo schaffen. Konkret heißt das:

  • Du baust dir deine eigene Pipeline auf: von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum gebuchten Demo-Termin, komplett eigenverantwortlich.

  • Du sprichst täglich mit ca. 60 potenziellen Kund:innen – am Telefon, per Cold Call und im Inbound-Gespräch – und entscheidest selbst, wie du sie überzeugst.

  • Du bist Teil von Messen und Events und bekommst dadurch Einblick, wie Nelly bei echten Kund:innen ankommt – nicht nur am Telefon.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Partnerships und Marketing zusammen und siehst, wie dein Beitrag den gesamten Sales-Zyklus verkürzt

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du hast Hunter-Mentalität und Can-do-Attitude – Telefonieren und Überzeugen ist für dich kein notwendiges Übel, sondern macht dir Spaß.

  • Dich Ablehnung am Telefon frustriert statt anzuspornen – Cold Calling gehört zum Alltag, nicht zur Ausnahme.

  • Du einen klar vorgezeichneten, unveränderlichen Prozess erwartest – der Inbound/Outbound-Split verschiebt sich je nach Lead-Lage, und du musst dich flexibel darauf einstellen.


Unser Interviewprozess:

  • First Call mit deiner TA Partnerin (online, 30 Minuten)

  • Second Call mit deinem potenziellen Team Lead (online, ca. 45 Minuten)

  • On Site Gespräch, ca 60 Minuten

  • BVG-Ticket oder Swapfiets-Mitgliedschaft, damit du schnell unterwegs bist

  • Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft, damit Bewegung und Ausgleich nicht zu kurz kommen

  • 500€ L&D Budget, um dich weiterzuentwickeln

  • 28 Urlaubstage, steigend, bis 30 Tage erreicht sind

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Hybrid-Setup

  • Bis zu 4 Wochen Workation

  • Ein hundefreundliches Büro mit guter Atmosphäre und einem Team mit dem es Spaß macht zu arbeiten

  • Snacks und ein Kühlschrank voller kalter Getränke

Wir leben Vielfalt und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter (m/w/d). Und weil wir wissen, dass Selbstzweifel oder das sogenannte Impostor-Syndrom oft davon abhalten, sich zu bewerben, gilt: Zögere nicht, auch wenn du nicht jedes einzelne Kriterium erfüllst. We're on a mission to create 10 million human firewalls! At revel8, we redefine cybersecurity training with hyper-realistic simulations that reflect today's evolving attack landscape. Our innovative platform combines AI-driven multi-channel attacks with gamified, real-time learning to build resilience where it matters most: the people.


Your mission

We opened our first office in Munich this year, and our team is growing fast. That means more people, more deliveries, more events, and more things that need someone to look after them. As our Working Student Office Management & Operations, you'll work directly with Melina, our Head of People & Culture, and make sure our Munich office is a place where the team loves to work. You'll know you're succeeding when things just work: the fridge is stocked, the meeting rooms are ready, the team event is booked, and nobody has to think twice about it.

How your day-to-day will look like:

  • Office Management: You own our Munich office and keep it running day to day. You handle orders for supplies, snacks and equipment, keep an eye on stock, and coordinate with vendors and building management.
  • Office Care: You're the one who keeps our office feeling like home. You unpack and put away deliveries, keep the spaces tidy, and take care of all the small things that make the office a place where people want to spend their day.
  • Event Planning: You plan and organize team events, offsites, team lunches and small rituals. You handle everything from gathering ideas and booking venues to managing budgets and making sure everything runs smoothly on the day.
  • Admin & Organization: You take care of the admin work that keeps our office running. You manage orders and invoices, keep office documents and trackers organized, and handle recurring operational tasks reliably.
  • Process & Automation: You spot recurring manual tasks and help us simplify or automate them, using AI tools, Notion templates or smarter workflows.
  • Ad-hoc Projects: You're our go-to person when something needs to get done, whether it's organizing a visit from partners, preparing welcome packages or sorting out a new office topic.
  • People & Recruiting Support: When needed, you lend our People & Culture team a hand, for example by preparing documents, updating Personio, helping with onboarding steps or coordinating interviews.


Is it you we are looking for?

You...

  • are currently enrolled as a student in Germany (field of study is open – what matters is how you work) and can commit 16–20 hours per week in our office.
  • are highly organized and reliable: you keep track of many small things at once, meet deadlines, and follow through without needing reminders.
  • are a "no task too small" person: you're as happy restocking the office as you are planning a team event or updating an employee file.
  • are hands-on and proactive: you see what needs to be done and just do it, and you prioritize done over perfect.
  • are a people person with good judgment: you communicate warmly and clearly, and you handle sensitive information discreetly.
  • are tool-fluent and AI-curious: you work confidently with Google Workspace, Notion and Slack, and you use AI tools to move faster.
  • communicate fluently in English, so you can collaborate easily with our international team.
Bonus:
  • German skills, which help when dealing with vendors, building management and admin topics
  • First experience in operations, office management, event organization or HR (e.g. through a previous job, internship or student organization)


Why revel8?

  • Our revelutionary Energy: Join a team that's ambitious, kind, and genuinely excited about what we're building. We move fast, we have fun, and we treat each other well.
  • Real ownership from day one: You won't just watch from the sidelines. You'll own real topics and see the impact of your work every day in a fast-growing startup.
  • Office-first in Munich: Our office is at Stiglmaierplatz in the heart of Munich, with unlimited coffee, table tennis and good vibes included.
  • Your Daily Balance: EGYM Wellpass so you can take care of your body while you're in startup mode.
  • Stay with us: We love growing talent we've already worked with, and strong working students often have a path to a full-time role after graduation.


Ready to join the revelution?

Perfect, let's talk!
Just submit your application, and we'll get back to you as soon as possible. In case you have any questions, feel free to reach out to Melina from our People & Culture Team. We're looking forward to receiving your application!

Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mehr mithalten können – während die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht?

Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland haben keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss. Gleichzeitig verändern Künstliche Intelligenz, Automatisierung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle ganze Branchen schneller, als das Bildungssystem reagieren kann. Der Fachkräftemangel ist längst strukturell – und mit ihm wächst die Dringlichkeit, Menschen gezielt und wirksam neu zu qualifizieren.

Genau hier setzt die Talentspring Academy Group an. Wir qualifizieren Menschen für die Arbeitswelt von morgen: digital, förderfähig und praxisnah. Unsere Weiterbildungen in KI, Marketing, Sales, HR und Future of Work orientieren sich an dem, was der Arbeitsmarkt tatsächlich braucht – für Menschen ohne Abschluss, Quereinsteiger:innen, Arbeitssuchende und Beschäftigte, die sich weiterentwickeln wollen.

Dabei verbinden wir die Agilität eines EdTechs mit der Reichweite etablierter Bildungsakteure: AI-first Lerntechnologie auf der einen Seite, über 900 Standorte durch strategische Partnerschaften im Bildungssektor auf der anderen. Als Werkstudent AI & Business Automation (m/w/d) arbeitest Du an der Schnittstelle von Business Building, künstlicher Intelligenz und operativer Umsetzung.

Gemeinsam mit unserem Venture- und Leadership-Team identifizierst Du Prozesse und Geschäftsbereiche, in denen AI und Automatisierung einen echten Unterschied machen können – und setzt die passenden Lösungen direkt mit um. Du bekommst früh viel Verantwortung und arbeitest an Themen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen – von Operations und Sales über Finance bis hin zu neuen Geschäftsmodellen. AI & Automation

  • Du identifizierst Prozesse mit Automatisierungspotenzial und entwickelst dafür konkrete Lösungen.
  • Du baust und optimierst AI-gestützte Workflows, Automationen und interne Tools, beispielsweise mit n8n, Make, APIs oder modernen AI-Tools.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen und übersetzt operative Herausforderungen in konkrete Lösungsansätze.
Data & Reporting
  • Du arbeitest mit Daten aus unterschiedlichen Systemen und hilfst dabei, relevante Kennzahlen transparent und nutzbar zu machen.
  • Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung von Reports und Dashboards.
  • Du analysierst Daten und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für operative und strategische Fragestellungen ab.
  • Du achtest darauf, dass Daten und Kennzahlen nachvollziehbar und belastbar sind.
Research & neue Technologien
  • Du beobachtest neue Entwicklungen rund um AI, Automation und digitale Geschäftsmodelle.
  • Du testest neue Tools und Technologien und bewertest deren Nutzen für Talentspring.
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und hast die Möglichkeit, neue Ansätze schnell in der Praxis auszuprobieren.


Das bringst Du mit

  • Studium & Verfügbarkeit: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert, beispielsweise in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Entrepreneurship, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang, und kannst uns ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen.
  • AI-Native Mindset: Du nutzt AI-Tools selbstverständlich in Deinem Alltag und hast Lust, Dich tief in neue Technologien und Anwendungen einzuarbeiten.
  • Hands-on Mentalität: Du möchtest nicht nur analysieren oder Präsentationen erstellen, sondern Dinge selbst bauen, ausprobieren und verbessern.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools, APIs, AI-Workflows oder Coding gesammelt – beispielsweise mit n8n, Make, Zapier, Python, JavaScript oder vergleichbaren Tools.
  • Businessverständnis: Du kannst Dich schnell in Geschäftsprozesse hineindenken und verstehst, dass eine technische Lösung nur dann gut ist, wenn sie ein echtes Problem löst.
  • Analytische Stärke: Du arbeitest strukturiert mit Daten, Kennzahlen und komplexen Fragestellungen und hinterfragst Ergebnisse kritisch.
  • Ownership: Du arbeitest selbstständig, bringst Themen aktiv voran und wartest nicht darauf, dass Dir jeder nächste Schritt vorgegeben wird.
  • Deutsch: Du kommunizierst mündlich und schriftlich sicher auf C2-Niveau, da die Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung mit unseren internen Teams überwiegend auf Deutsch stattfindet.
  • Englisch: Du kannst Dich sicher mit englischsprachigen Tools, Dokumentationen und technischen Ressourcen bewegen.


Was wir Dir bieten

  • AI nicht nur in der Theorie: Du entwickelst Lösungen, die direkt im Unternehmen eingesetzt werden.
  • Echter Business Impact: Deine Arbeit beeinflusst unmittelbar, wie effizient und skalierbar unsere Teams arbeiten.
  • Viel Verantwortung: Du bekommst eigene Themen und Projekte statt klassischer Werkstudent.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Venture- und Leadership-Team zusammen.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du bekommst Einblick in AI, Automation, Operations und Business Building gleichzeitig.
  • Flexibilität neben dem Studium: Die Rolle ist auf ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche ausgelegt und lässt sich mit Deinem Studium verbinden.
  • Berlin & Teamnähe: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team in Berlin zusammen und bekommst direkten Einblick in ein wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen.


Unser Bekenntnis zur Chancengleichheit

Wir bei Talentspring sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechtsidentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Talentspring steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor. Uns ist es besonders wichtig, das jede:r sich zu seinem/ihrem vollsten Potential entwickelt und in keinster Weise Benachteiligung erfährt. Wir sind stolz auf unser diverses Team und stellen sicher, dass wir in jeder Besetzung diese gelebte Diversität auch erfüllen.

title: Security Engineer - UK - Remote
description:
Job Description

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time.

Key responsibilities:

  • Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand.

  • Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools.

  • Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration).

  • Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself.

  • Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating.

  • Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling.

Your background:

  • A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work.

  • Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration.

  • Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast.

  • Some exposure to compliance or audit evidence gathering (Vanta or similar) is a bonus, not required.

  • A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet.

  • A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human).

  • You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners).

  • You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners).

  • You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple).

 

KPIs & Success Measures

  • Access reviews and joiner/mover/leaver tasks completed within SLA, with zero access-control audit findings.

  • Endpoint compliance rate (encryption, patching, MDM enrolment) across the device fleet.

  • Time-to-close on security incidents and IT/device issues you support.

  • Quality and completeness of evidence you contribute to Vanta and vendor reviews.

 

Benefits:

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We’re called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group’s mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco Itaú, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of Pokémon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content,, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund).

The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. It was named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies 2021 by Fast Company, and by CB Insights as one of the World's Most Valuable Private Unicorns.

You’ll own computer vision on the device, taking detection and tracking models and making them work reliably on consumer Android phones and tablets.

That means much more than getting a model to run. You’ll optimise and profile inference for real-world hardware, balancing performance with accuracy across different devices, lighting conditions and environments. You’ll work close to the camera capture pipeline, where frame timing, exposure and device behaviour can all affect the quality of the output.

Your challenge is to ensure that the data produced on a mobile device is accurate, reliable and trusted by the wider tracking system.

You’ll work closely with mobile, backend, computer vision and machine learning engineers, with the freedom to own both your technical approach and its implementation. We also embrace AI-augmented and AI-delegated development as part of how we work, enabling a small team to build and iterate at pace.

  • Own on-device inference: Design and implement Android inference solutions that meet demanding accuracy, latency and performance requirements.

  • Build the native Android vision layer: Develop and maintain C++ components using the Android NDK, alongside JNI bindings that connect them to our Kotlin application.

  • Optimise models for mobile: Convert, quantise, profile and optimise detection and tracking models, exploring techniques such as pruning, graph optimisation and operator-level improvements.

  • Solve real-world camera challenges: Work close to the capture pipeline, understanding how frame timing, exposure and camera behaviour influence model performance.

  • Mobile or embedded inference runtimes, including model conversion and quantisation toolchains.

  • Model optimisation and performance profiling for resource-constrained hardware.

  • C++, particularly the Android NDK and JNI.

  • Measuring and validating model accuracy against ground truth.

You’ll also be comfortable with:

  • Kotlin, with enough experience to work effectively across the JNI boundary.

  • Python for prototyping, tooling and data analysis.

  • Mobile camera capture pipelines, including frame timing and exposure control.

  • Machine learning fundamentals, allowing you to contribute meaningfully to discussions about model improvements.

  • Git, code reviews and continuous integration practices.

It would be beneficial to understand:

You don’t need to have worked with every technology listed. We’re interested in the depth of your engineering experience, your ability to solve difficult problems and your willingness to learn.

Our technology

Our stack includes C++, Android NDK, JNI, Kotlin, Python and AWS, supported by Git, GitHub Actions, Jira and Android mobile inference and profiling tools.

At Hawk-Eye, you'll have the opportunity to work on technology used across the world's leading sports while solving complex technical challenges alongside talented engineers and product teams. description:

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

About The Role

We are seeking a Bioinformatics Software Engineer to drive the flow cytometry data engineering infrastructure, annotation pipelines, model registry operations, and code governance for an advanced clinical biomarker discovery platform operating under machine learning industry best practices and Medical Device Machine Learning (MedDev ML) standards.

In this role, you will be responsible for translating high-dimensional flow cytometry data into reproducible, production-grade features compliant with industry best practices and MedDev ML framework requirements. Your key deliverables will include frozen, reproducible feature pipelines and locked model registry artifacts. You will oversee automated cell-type annotation, manage model artifact registries, enforce data integrity, trace compliance, and handle leakage controls across machine learning partitions while leading peer code reviews.

Core Responsibilities

  • Flow Cytometry Data Engineering & Annotation Pipelines: Execute automated cell annotation workflows on large-scale cytometry datasets; generate cell membership files, cell subset ratio tables, and automated outlier quality-control (QC) reports. Apply locked automated gating ensembles across cross-validation and evaluation partitions, tracking and recording per-patient gating exposure metrics. Establish and lock baseline models and numerical stability criteria for flow cytometry feature extraction pipelines.

  • Model Registry & Governance: Manage the formal model lifecycle registry—versioning, freezing, and locking gating ensembles and candidate predictive models in adherence with industry best practices and MedDev ML regulatory frameworks. Refit shortlisted machine learning models on expanded cohorts and execute final model freezing prior to blinded clinical evaluations. Ensure full reproducibility by committing versioned code, pinning environment specifications (Conda/Docker), and logging all random seeds and model hyperparameters.

 

  • Code Quality, Review & Data Integrity: Serve as a primary code reviewer across the computational pipeline, enforcing strict data leakage controls, data integrity checks, and modular coding standards. Participate in Independent Method Reviews (IMRs), traceability audits, and regulatory compliance verification under industry best practices and MedDev ML guidelines while interfacing closely with Machine Learning Engineers, Bio-statisticians, and Clinical Scientists.

Team and Ways of Working

Embedded in a multidisciplinary team of 4 (ML Engineers, Biostatisticians, and Clinical Scientists) reporting directly to the Lead Data Scientist.

Qualification Requirements

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Statistics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Bioengineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • 3+ years of professional experience handling flow cytometry high-throughput data in regulated, academic, or biotech settings.

Technical Must-Haves (Essential Skills)

  • Programming Mastery: Fluent in Python (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch).

  • Software Engineering & Version Control: Proven experience with software engineering best practices: Git version control, CI/CD, workflow managers (Nextflow), environment pinning (Docker), and ML artifact tracking.

  • Cytometry Knowledge: Familiarity with flow cytometry feature generation and batch-effect harmonisation.

  • Familiarity with cross-validation leakage traps in high-dimensional flow cytometry predictive modeling.

Nice-to-Haves (Desirable Skills)

  • Experience working with clinical trial datasets, industry best practices, and MedDev ML regulations.

  • Experience in transplant immunology, oncology, or hematologic malignancies.

description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Wayve’s Talent Acquisition team plays a critical role in our success. We hire the people who build and ship our autonomous driving technology. • Helping build the high-performing, diverse technical and product teams that drive Wayve’s innovation and business impact as the company scales.

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

title: Senior Commercial Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Avenir Collective. Building the future of beauty, personal care and lifestyle brands.

We acquire and scale high-potential consumer brands, bringing together the capital, people and operating expertise to turn strong brands into enduring businesses. Our difference is that we are operators, actively managing our brands and providing the capabilities, infrastructure and expertise they need to scale, while preserving the product, purpose and consumer connection that make each brand special.

We’re building a connected house of brands where great people, brands and ideas come together. If you’re excited by building businesses, solving problems and working with a collaborative, entrepreneurial team, we’d love to hear from you.


Your role at a Glance 

 

As a Senior Commercial Finance Manager in our Finance team, you will play a key role in supporting the Group Finance Director and wider leadership team by delivering accurate, timely and insightful financial reporting. Your main focus will be leading the preparation of Group reporting, budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring financial information is clear, meaningful and supports better business decisions through close collaboration with stakeholders across the organisation.

This role is ideal for someone with strong commercial finance expertise and a proactive, analytical mindset, who enjoys working closely with senior stakeholders and using financial insight to influence business performance. Your work will directly impact how we understand our performance, manage costs and identify opportunities for growth across the business.

Location & Flexibility 

  • Full-time, permanent role based at our modern office in Holborn, London 

  • Working Hours: 40 hours per week, 9 am to 6 pm with a one-hour lunch  

  • This position is hybrid, with the expectation to go to the London office at least 2 or 3 days per week

Key responsibilities

Group Reporting 
• Prepare the Group's monthly management reporting. 
• Produce reporting for the Executive Leadership Team and Board. 
• Analyse revenue, gross margin, operating costs and EBITDA. 
• Prepare clear commentary explaining business performance, key movements, risks and opportunities. 
• Investigate queries from the Group Finance Director and senior leaders, providing clear answers and recommendations. 
• Continue to improve reporting, KPIs and dashboards. 
 
Budgeting and Forecasting 
• Support the forecasting process. 
• Support the annual budget process. 
• Prepare financial models and scenario analysis. 
• Monitor performance against budget and forecast, explaining key variances. 
• Highlight risks and opportunities early. 
 
OPEX Reporting 
• Prepare the Group's operating expense reporting. 
• Work closely with budget holders to review monthly spend. 
• Lead regular meetings with budget holders to review performance and forecasts. 
• Prepare monthly operating expense forecasts. 
• Investigate and explain significant variances. 
• Identify opportunities to improve cost control and reporting. 
 
Business Partnering 
• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the business. 
• Provide financial support and challenge where needed. 
• Help managers understand their financial performance. 
• Support business cases and commercial decisions with clear financial analysis. 
 
Month End 
• Work with the Financial Control team to ensure accurate month-end reporting. 
• Prepare monthly variance analysis and supporting commentary. 
• Support ad hoc analysis and reporting as required. 
 
Continuous Improvement 
• Improve reporting, forecasting and planning processes. 
• Look for opportunities to automate and simplify reporting. 
• Help improve the quality and consistency of financial information.  

About you

  • ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified with strong experience in Commercial Finance, FP&A or Finance Business Partnering roles.

  • Proven experience preparing management reporting, budgets, forecasts and financial models in a commercial environment.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial information and translate it into actionable insights.

  • Confident communicator with experience partnering with senior stakeholders and explaining financial concepts to non-finance teams.

  • Advanced Excel skills, with experience using financial systems such as NetSuite and reporting tools such as Power BI desirable.

  • Experience working within consumer products, retail, e-commerce or another fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Build strong relationships with budget holders. 

  • Become the first point of contact for commercial finance reporting and analysis. 

  • Improve the quality and efficiency of reporting. 

  • Provide clear answers and insight that support better business decisions.

title: Principal Consultant in Science, Technology & Innovation Policy
description:
Introduction

Ready to use your expertise to shape the future of science, technology and innovation policy across Europe?
At Technopolis, you work on complex policy challenges at Dutch, European and international level. You lead studies, evaluations and advisory projects for policymakers and public organisations, turning solid research and analysis into insights that help shape policy and decision-making.

As a Principal Consultant, you combine substantive expertise with project leadership, client advice and business development. You lead complex projects, build client relationships, identify new opportunities and develop proposals. From our Amsterdam office, you work with an experienced international team where expertise, collaboration and entrepreneurship come together.


About this job

You take overall responsibility for complex studies, evaluations and advisory projects at the intersection of science, technology, innovation and public policy. You develop robust approaches using qualitative and quantitative research methods and are responsible for quality, planning, budgets, deliverables and client communication.

Alongside delivering projects, you advise clients, build relationships with clients, partners and stakeholders and contribute to business development. You also share your expertise across our international offices and guide less experienced consultantsin their project work and professional development.

A few examples of our work 
Recent projects include the evaluation of the Digital Europe Programme, the impact assessment of FP10, a study on equal opportunities for researchers across Europe and benchmarking the technology position of European Member States.


Your profile

Are you the person we are looking for?
You are an experienced consultant or policy researcher who combines strong analytical expertise with project leadership, client advice and businessdevelopment. You know your field, understand the European policy landscape and enjoy using your expertise not only to deliver excellent work, but also to develop new opportunities.

  • A relevant university degree and 7–10 years of experience in science, technology and innovation policy, policy research, policy advice, policy evaluation, public governance or related fields. Affinity with policy regarding entrepreneurship and/or private sector development is a plus.
  • A proven track record in leading studies, advisory and/or evaluation projects, preferably in an international or European context.
  • A relevant network and good understanding of developments in science, technology and innovation policy at European level. Experience in the Dutch policy landscape is a plus.
  • Experience with business development and writing project proposals.
  • Strong analytical, project management and advisory skills, combined with excellent written and spoken English. Dutch is a plus.
  • A proactive and collaborative approach to working in an international team.


Your responsibilities

As a Principal Consultant, you have the freedom and responsibility to bring projects from complex policy questions to clear advice. At the same time, you look beyond your own projects by building relationships, developing new business opportunities and helping colleagues grow.

  • Lead complex studies, evaluations and advisory projects, with responsibility for quality, planning, budgets, deliverables and client communication.
  • Develop strong research and evaluation approaches and translate complex findings into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Advise clients, build and maintain relationships with clients, partners and stakeholders and develop new business opportunities and project proposals.
  • Work with consultants across our international offices and contribute to knowledge sharing and the development of our science, technology and innovation policy and evaluation practice.
  • Guide, support and coach less experienced consultants in their project work and professional development.


Our offer

At Technopolis, you combine intellectually challenging and meaningful work with the personal atmosphere of our Amsterdam team. Our office is located in a historic building on Spuistraat, right in the heart of Amsterdam and easily accessible by public transport.

We are ambitious and professional, but informal in the way we work together. We have lunch together, play table football, organise team activities and celebrate our successes. You also work closely with colleagues across our international offices and meet during our Technodays for workshops, knowledge sharing and a big celebration.

We offer:

  • A position of 32–40 hours per week.
  • An initial one-year contract, with the prospect of a permanent position.
  • A gross monthly salary of €4,000–€6,500 based on a 40 hour working week, depending on experience, plus an annual bonus based on individual performance and company results.
  • 30 days of annual leave based on a full-time position.
  • A flexible working environment with opportunities for remote working.
  • Participation in Technopolis Group’s pension scheme.
  • A laptop, mobile phone with subscription and, if you live outside Amsterdam, an NS Business Card for first class commuting.
  • The opportunity to further develop your expertise in science policy, create new propositions and strengthen this area of expertise within Technopolis Group, together with experienced colleagues from our Dutch and international offices.


Interested? Apply directly

Ready to use your expertise to lead complex projects, advise clients and help shape the future of our science, technology and innovation policy practice? We would like to hear from you.

description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.

This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:

OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

  • Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.

LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

  • Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

  • Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

  • Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.

METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

  • Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

  • Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

  • Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.

CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

  • Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

  • Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Billing or licensing product experience: You have 6+ years in Product, with a substantial part spent owning a billing, licensing, entitlement, or quote-to-cash system at a B2B SaaS company.

  • Shipped through Finance and RevOps: You've driven a cross-functional systems change where Finance, Sales Ops, and Engineering all had a say, and you got it live.

  • Systems and data-model depth: You can design or critique an entity model, reason about reconciliation and idempotency in a sync, read an API contract, and explain why two systems reading the same events end up with different numbers.

  • Attention to detail: You know that if the billing data is wrong, everything built on it inherits the error, and you sequence work accordingly.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or data-quality work to commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You're equally at home with engineers, the Finance team, and Sales, and you can make billing trade-offs legible to all of them.

  • Enterprise reality: You understand what self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments mean for licensing and metering.

Nice-to-haves

  • Usage-based billing: You've owned usage-based or hybrid (subscription plus usage) billing.

  • Vendor billing stacks: You've worked hands-on with Paddle, Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora or similar, and know where they break at enterprise contract volume.

  • Migration experience: You've run a billing-provider migration.

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code, query data, or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • CRM integration: You've worked on Salesforce or CRM-to-billing integrations.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, agent orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll be in the middle of the AI revolution. The shift from deterministic automation to agent autonomy is a genuinely open design space, and n8n has a credible claim to owning it. Every plan we sell, every enterprise contract, and every agent run that gets metered and billed runs on the foundation you own: licensing, entitlements, accounts, and the billing platform across Cloud and Enterprise. Your work directly shapes how n8n makes money and how easily customers can buy, grow, and trust what they pay for, from self-serve Cloud to air-gapped and OEM deployments.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest growing startups at the sweet spot: small enough to have real impact and be empowered, big enough that your work already reaches massive scale and serious enterprise customers. You'll work with experienced engineers, Finance, and go-to-market on problems where the details are the product, in an AI-native, empowered culture of humble, kind, yet driven and direct people, where you're hired to think, not just to execute. And with our fair-code model, a passionate open-source community gives you a direct feedback loop on everything you ship.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now, and help us build the commercial foundation of the future of reliable AI automation.

engineers.

title: Software Engineer, Foundation
description:
Job Description

In short: We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our foundation team with a focus on mobile. You don't need to have years of experience in platform engineering But, you do need to have shipped real production software, to care about how things are built, and to already be working with agentic coding tools every day.

We're building the #1 AI learning companion for 1 billion students. A future where every student on the planet can access, enjoy & benefit from the highest quality education. Since founding Knowunity straight out of high school in 2020, we've been committed to revolutionising how students learn.

Millions of students already use our AI learning companion weekly. We just raised €27m - Europe’s largest education round in the past three years. The AI learning market is at an inflection point, finally enabling true personalisation at scale, and we're determined to build the first AI learning unicorn in this space.

You will join an elite team of +60 hands-on builders serving 1 billion students worldwide. If we execute on our product vision, you will have built something generational that transforms education globally. This is your chance to build a generational company that shapes how an entire generation learns.

 


What makes this different

You build at the frontier of AI engineering. We’re building the foundation for agents to build fast and with high quality on our code base. This includes custom MCP servers, our background agent platform, and end-to-end agentic loops. This is an open engineering problem, not a solved one, and you'll be shaping our answer to it.

Your work multiplies across 25+ engineers. A design system component you build gets used in a hundred screens. A CI pipeline you cut from 15 minutes to 2 gives the whole org back a day a week. Foundation is the highest-leverage place in our engineering org, and the leverage is measurable.

Millions of students use what you ship. Foundation isn't a team that only builds for other engineers. You'll also build features that land in front of millions of users.

Real ownership, early. We're a small team with a large surface. You'll own meaningful pieces of the app and the toolchain from your first months.

Craft is taken seriously. We care how the app feels: how a sheet animates, how a list scrolls under load, how a component behaves at the edges. If you've ever been quietly annoyed by four pixels, you'll fit in here.

Find out more here!: This AI studying app with 25M+ downloads is built with Flutter

 


What you'll work on

Mobile foundation. The core of our Flutter app: shared components, the design system, state management, performance, and the tooling around it. You'll extend it, keep it healthy, and make it obvious for product teams to use correctly.

Agentic and AI infrastructure. MCP servers, our background agent platform, evals and feedback loops, and the integration of agentic tooling into our day-to-day workflow. A research background isn't required; a serious interest in agents as an engineering discipline is.

Developer experience. CI/CD, release tooling, and the feedback loop between writing code and seeing it live. Much of this work starts by noticing the same friction three times and deciding to remove it.

Product features. Shipping user-facing work alongside platform work, both to move the product and to stay honest about what it's actually like to build on our foundation.

Reliability and maintenance. Keeping what exists dependable, so 25+ engineers can build on it without thinking about it.



You will grow at Knowunity by

  • Learning architecture by doing it. You'll make real design decisions on the app's core, with review and mentorship from engineers who have architected mobile apps at scale. You'll see those decisions tested by 25 engineers and millions of users within weeks.

  • Becoming genuinely strong at agentic engineering. Almost nobody is an expert here yet. You'll be building the practice for a whole engineering org while the field is still being written.

  • Widening past mobile. Foundation's scope covers Go services, infrastructure, and delivery. You'll be expected to have opinions beyond the app, and you'll have the room to develop them.

  • Working close to the whole org. Platform work means talking to every team. You'll get an unusually complete picture of how a product organisation actually functions, faster than you would inside a single product team.

  • Operating at real scale. Millions of users, 26 countries, and a codebase where "it works on my machine" isn't the finish line.



What we're looking for

Must haves

  • A few years of production experience building mobile (we use Flutter and Dart) or web applications.

  • Daily use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and opinions on where they work well, where they don't, and how to work around it.

  • An eye for design. You notice when spacing is inconsistent, when an animation feels wrong, when a component is close but not right.

  • Clear communication in English and a genuine preference for improving systems that slow other people down, whether or not your name ends up on a shipped feature.

Nice to haves

  • Built mobile apps with Flutter

  • Worked with Golang (or similar backend language)

  • Anything you've built with agents, MCP, or evals.

title: AI Deployment Strategist – MedTech Quality Management
description:
About REMATIQ

REMATIQ is changing how MedTech teams develop, document, and launch medical devices by building a highly specialised AI platform for regulated R&D, quality, and regulatory workflows.

We work with leading life sciences and MedTech companies to help them move faster while improving quality, traceability, and compliance. We are looking for an AI Deployment Strategist – MedTech Quality Management to help our customers transform complex quality and QMS workflows into practical AI-powered solutions.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

What you’ll do

As an AI Deployment Strategist – MedTech Quality Management at REMATIQ, you will work closely with customers, Delivery, Product, and Engineering to drive customer projects, understand how MedTech quality teams work today, and help translate their workflows into high-impact AI use cases.

This is not an academic advisory role. You will be hands-on in customer projects, helping structure problems, drive workstreams, create materials, review outputs, and turn domain expertise into practical solutions.

You will:

  • Own and drive customer project workstreams from discovery through workflow design, implementation support, testing, iteration, and delivery.

  • Work directly with Quality, Operations, R&D, Regulatory, and cross-functional customer teams to understand their QMS processes and documentation, including SOPs and work instructions, CAPA and nonconformance handling, complaints and post-market surveillance, change control, supplier quality, audit readiness, and related product-development records, as well as the constraints, pain points, and opportunities for AI-powered improvement.

  • Bring deep MedTech quality management expertise across areas such as ISO 13485, FDA QMSR / 21 CFR Part 820, MDSAP, ISO 14971 risk management, design controls, CAPA, deviations, supplier quality, and internal and external audits — and act as a domain sparring partner for internal teams.

  • Create and review project deliverables such as customer workshop materials, process and workflow maps, QMS and standards gap analyses, impact assessments, target process designs, use-case specifications, and AI-generated outputs together with customer subject-matter experts.

  • Collect customer learnings and feedback and translate them into structured internal feedback for Product and Engineering.

  • Use AI tools actively to speed up your own work, create high-quality outputs faster, and improve how customer projects are delivered.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for someone who combines deep MedTech quality management expertise, strong project ownership, customer-facing communication, and a hands-on execution mindset.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • 5–8 years of relevant experience in MedTech quality management, QA/QM, QMS ownership, quality systems, quality operations, or a related consulting role.

  • Practical understanding of how a medical device QMS operates day to day, including areas such as document and change control, design controls, risk management, verification & validation, CAPA and nonconformance handling, complaints and post-market surveillance, supplier quality, training and competence, management review, and audits and inspections — and the ability to translate this expertise into AI-enabled use cases, project deliverables, and structured product feedback.

  • Strong project ownership: you can structure ambiguous work, align stakeholders, manage risks, define next steps, and drive cross-functional customer projects from problem understanding to delivery.

  • Strong customer-facing communication: you can build trust with Quality, Regulatory, Operations, R&D, and senior stakeholders, ask sharp questions, and explain complex topics clearly.

  • Hands-on execution mindset: you are comfortable creating materials, mapping workflows, reviewing outputs, synthesising findings, adapting to changing priorities, and driving work forward yourself.

  • Comfort with speed and change: REMATIQ is growing extremely fast, with the organisation doubling every 9–12 months. You are comfortable operating in a high-speed, high-agency environment with rapidly changing scope and responsibilities.

  • AI savviness: you actively use AI tools to improve your own work, move faster, create better deliverables, and explore new ways of working.

  • Fluency in English; German is a strong plus for German-speaking customer work.

Why join REMATIQ?

  • Rare timing: Join REMATIQ at a pivotal stage as we move from Seed toward Series A and prepare to significantly grow the team.

  • Real ownership: Own high-impact customer projects and see your work translate directly into outcomes for leading MedTech and life sciences companies.

  • Direct exposure: Work closely with founders, customers, product teams, and technical experts while building a network across the global MedTech and life sciences industry.

  • Purposeful work: Be part of a mission-driven team transforming how medical devices reach the market — in an industry where quality, compliance, and patient safety mean nothing can be left to chance.

  • Compensation & growth: Competitive salary plus equity, giving you a stake in the success you help create.

Build the product engine behind the next generation of MedTech software.

REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands.

We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

Now we’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead / Head of Product to help us turn ambitious product direction into exceptional shipped product.

The role

This is a player-coach role for someone who wants real product ownership without moving away from the product itself.

Our founder will continue to lead long-term product strategy, major capability bets and the frontier of where REMATIQ should go.

You will own how we get there.

You’ll take responsibility for the full product execution loop:

Customer insight → product ideas → prioritization → definition → engineering refinement → sprint execution → shipped product → learning.

You’ll lead a growing team of 2–3 Product Managers, raise the quality bar across the product organization, and still directly own one or two of our most important and complex product areas yourself.

  • Own product execution end to end: Turn strategic direction and customer insight into clear priorities, well-defined product work and shipped outcomes.

  • Stay hands-on: Personally lead discovery, define product requirements, make prioritization decisions and own some of our hardest product areas.

  • Run product across multiple squads: Create clarity across Product, Engineering and Design and ensure teams move from idea to execution without unnecessary process or ambiguity.

  • Make the hard calls: Navigate competing customer needs, technical constraints and incomplete information, and make clear product decisions rather than simply facilitating consensus.

  • Build an AI-native product organization: Use AI deeply in your own work and help rethink how discovery, specification, prototyping, analysis and product development should work in an AI-first company.

  • Stay close to customers: Understand how sophisticated enterprise teams actually work, identify the problems worth solving and turn customer insight into scalable product rather than one-off features.

  • Continuously improve how we build: Identify where our product process needs more structure, where it needs less, and build the operating rhythm that helps REMATIQ ship better and faster as we scale.

What we’re looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Have led product for a B2B enterprise software product.

  • Have directly managed at least 2 Product Managers.

  • Are still deeply hands-on and comfortable running discovery, writing and refining product requirements, prioritizing trade-offs and working closely with Engineering.

  • Are genuinely AI-forward: you actively use AI in your work, understand how it changes product development, and have thoughtful views on what makes a product truly AI-native.

  • Communicate exceptionally well, both in writing and in conversation.

  • Operate with high ownership, pace and reliability.

We’ll be especially excited if you

  • Have been a founder, founding PM or very early product leader and can demonstrate founder-like ownership.

  • Are technically strong enough to work deeply with engineers on APIs, data, AI systems, workflows and technical trade-offs.
